issue.title: test: TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged is red wherever /bin/sh's echo leaves \n as written (bash as sh), green on dash
issue.body:
Found while running the full suite on Linux (Arch, `/bin/sh -> bash`), on main 87d703c5.

## What is red

```sh
GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 go test -tags nogui -count=1 -run TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged ./internal/gateway/
--- FAIL: TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged (0.00s)
    claude_client_cache_test.go:291: ordinary prompt changed: ...
```

Red on every run (5/5 with `-count=5`), on a clean checkout of 87d703c5, with `umask 022`. It is red at e72b6a33 and d9e87eb3 (#1717) too, and at every later commit that touches `internal/gateway/claude_subscription.go` (20c06883, e183604f, f550d369, ec645439).

## Why

The harness script (`newScriptHarness`, internal/gateway/claude_resume_test.go) logs each turn with

```sh
echo "told $line" >> $log
```

The body it is given holds the prompt's newlines JSON-escaped (literal `\n`). The test expects them as **real** newlines in the log:

```go
"...\u003c/external_system_instructions\u003e\n\n"   // real LF, LF
```

so the expectation is only met when the shell's `echo` re-interprets backslash escapes:

- dash (Ubuntu CI's /bin/sh): `echo "a\nb"` prints a real newline — the test passes.
- bash as /bin/sh (Arch; and macOS /bin/sh is bash 3.2 as sh, whose echo also leaves `\n` unless xpg_echo): `echo "a\nb"` prints `a\nb` — the test is red.

```
$ sh -c 'echo "a\nb"' | od -c        # here (bash as sh)
0000000   a   \   n   b   \n
```

So the test's own harness depends on the shell's `echo` escape handling, and any machine without dash as /bin/sh sees the package red.

## Fix direction

Log with `printf 'told %s\n' "$line"` (no escape re-interpretation, same bytes on every shell) and hold the test's expectation to the literal `\n` the body carries — or make the harness unescape deliberately and say so. Any other assertion in the resume tests that spans a newline in a told line is riding the same dash behavior and would need the same pass.

comments.body:
Fixed in my fork: [ef857324](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/ef857324101d0588b713f50b1b1304324a96bb3d), branch `fix/claude-harness-bytes`.

The shared harness now writes its data with fixed-format `printf '%s\n'`, covering logs, control messages, session JSONL and replies. The cache test decodes the logged JSON and checks the actual prompt and cache-control values, instead of expecting shell-dependent escaped bytes. No production behavior changed.

The original test failed on Bash-as-sh. Keeping the new JSON assertion but restoring the old harness also failed under `BASHOPTS=xpg_echo` with an invalid newline in JSON. The fix passed five consecutive runs in each Bash mode; the related cache/resume/lean/room tests passed in both modes too. Tests ran in a temporary HOME with pinned Go caches. Dash was not installed, so I have not claimed a dash runtime test.

Combined validation: these changes are included in [065f0c8f](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/065f0c8ffc9e30225f3d468ef41ec414aab75e02) on `fix/issue-batch-20261023`. At that exact commit, `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m`, native/Linux/Windows vet and native/Linux/Windows builds all passed with Go 1.26.8, a temporary HOME and pinned Go caches (Linux host, umask 027). Cross-platform builds/vet are not Windows runtime tests. These full-suite results apply to the combined commit; the focused results above apply to the individual fix.

issue.title: gateway: 火山方舟月度额度用尽后每 15 分钟被重试一次 —— "reset at … +0800 CST" 不被 resetsWhen 读，套餐窗口也没进路由

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body: ## 现象 Ark Coding Plan 的本月额度用尽后，路由页上这个成员一直显示 `额度用尽 · N 分钟后恢复`，N 在 9–15 之间循环——也就是每 15 分钟被放出来问一次、再被 429、再休 15 分钟。 ### 截图 用量卡片（AccessKey 读的控制面读数，`本月 剩余 0%`）： 路由页上同一个成员： 同一时刻的用量卡片（`magpie quota volcengine --json`，AccessKey 读控制面）： ```json {"name":"5 hours","used":37.248,"resetsAt":"2026-10-22T18:57:56+08:00"} {"name":"Weekly", "used":59.651,"resetsAt":"2026-10-26T00:00:00+08:00"} {"name":"Month", "used":100, "resetsAt":"2026-10-25T23:59:59+08:00"} ``` `magpie quota wait volcengine` 也据此说 `volcengine is used up until Sun 23:59`。所以 magpie 手上有这条信息，只是网关路由拿不到。 ## Ark 的 429 自己写了重置时间 ```sh curl https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3/chat/completions \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARK_KEY" -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -d '{"model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":1}' ``` ``` HTTP/1.1 429 (无 Retry-After) {"error":{"code":"AccountQuotaExceeded","type":"TooManyRequests", "message":"You have exceeded the monthly usage quota. It will reset at 2026-10-25 23:59:59 +0800 CST. …"}} ``` ## 怎么发生的 `restAfterMarked`（`internal/gateway/routing.go:813`）对 failQuota 的次序是 `resetsAt(body)` → `c.full(now)` → `retryAfter(header)` → `quotaRest`。前两级在这里都是 0： 1. `resetsAt`（`routing.go:630`）依次试 `resetsWords` / `resetsIn` / `resetsWritten`（`resetsWhen`，`routing.go:220`）/ `resetsZhipu` / `resetsAfter`。`resetsWhen` 要求 `UTC|GMT` 紧跟偏移与标点： ``` (?:\bresets? at|将在|将于)\s*…\s*(?:UTC|GMT)([+-])(\d{1,2})(?::?(\d{2}))?(?:\s*(?:重置|[,.;，。；])) ``` Ark 的 `… reset at 2026-10-25 23:59:59 +0800 CST.` 没有 `UTC`/`GMT`，偏移是 `+0800`，后面还跟着时区缩写 `CST`——三处都不满足，返回 0。这与 #1669 修掉的 WorkBuddy `UTC+8` 是同一族措辞，`+0800 CST` 是漏网的那一种。 2. `c.full(now)`（`routing.go:1079`）走 `candidate.allowance()`（`routing.go:1086`）：订阅账号读 `allowances`，key 读 `keyAllowance`。Ark 的 `readsKeyWindows`（`internal/provider/key_allowance.go:58`）为 false —— `planQuotaSourceOf` 里没有 `ark.*.volces.com`；Ark 的套餐窗口只由 `volcPlanQuotas`（`internal/provider/volcengine_usage.go:95`，AccessKey 读控制面）产出卡片，那条路不出 `noteKeyAllowance`（对照 `internal/provider/planquota.go:712`）。#1427 的 PR 文案已写明「用量卡片尚未接入路由，刻意留到本次改动之外」，所以这一级为 0 是已知缺口。 于是落到 `quotaRest = 15 * time.Minute`（`routing.go:156`，注释即 "out of quota, with no word of when it resets"），`By: "quota"`。路由页把它画成 `额度用尽 · N 分钟后恢复`（`internal/gui/assets/plugins/routing/client.js:1801`、`:3039`，倒计时由 `restWhen` `:531` 算）——那个数字看着像「额度 10 分钟后恢复」，其实是休息本身。 ## 期望 - 最低：厂商说了 10-25 23:59，就休到那时，而不是 15 分钟后再去撞一次 429； - 更好：Ark（以及同类「用 AccessKey 读套餐窗口」的 Token Plan）的窗口进路由，Smart 不再把它当「额度未知」，也就不会每 15 分钟白试一次。 ## 修复建议（两层，可各自独立） 1. `resetsWhen` 接受 `±HHMM` / `±HH:MM` 偏移，并允许偏移后跟可选时区缩写（`CST` 等）再是 `重置`/标点；`+0800` 按偏移读，不要退回 UTC。 2. Ark / Token Plan 接入路由：`volcPlanQuotas` 读完调 `noteKeyAllowance`，`readsKeyWindows` 对 `TakesVolcAccessKey` 为真。注意配额属于账号、不属于单个推理 key（#1427 已提），以及「一个 provider 只能有一个套餐」（#2849）。 ## 旁注 Ark 侧的计数像是有延迟：用量在 15:53 就掉到 0%，16:08/16:09 的请求仍返回 200，16:52 起才稳定 429。所以这个 15 分钟循环偶尔会「看起来能用」。 ## 版本 magpie 0.1.1318 (7dd965ed)，Linux x64。 关联：#1669、#1772、#1427。

issue.title: 火山引擎返回的429重置时间不识别

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
你好，想提一个火山方舟 429 配额重置时间的原生支持需求。

当前现象：
magpie 对 429 的重置时间主要识别 `UTC+8` / `GMT+8` 这类格式，但火山方舟 Ark 返回的是：

{
  "error": {
    "code": "AccountQuotaExceeded",
    "message": "You have exceeded the monthly usage quota. It will reset at 2026-10-31 23:59:59 +0800 CST."
  }
}

因为 `+0800 CST` 匹配不到，magpie 会走 quotaRest 兜底。现在默认只休 15 分钟，导致已经月配额耗尽的 key 会被周期性重试；如果手动调大 quotaRest，又会被 8 天上限截断，而且不同 key 的真实重置时间并不一样，固定值容易提前或延后恢复。

期望的原生行为：
1. 解析 `+0800 CST` 这种数字时区 + 时区缩写的重置时间。
2. 对 Ark 的 `AccountQuotaExceeded` 月度配额错误，按错误里给的真实重置时间休息。
3. 如果 8 天限制是通用保护，建议通过 provider 级配置或 preset 级 parser/quotaRestMax 支持，而不是全局放开所有厂商。

可以用这个真实 429 作为回归用例，期望 routing 里记录：

fail=quota
by=resets
until=<错误中的真实重置时间>

目前我的临时方案是在每台机器上部署一个本地反向代理，再把 ark-code / ark-plan 的 provider URL 指过去；如果能原生支持，就可以省掉每台机器的代理和 URL 覆盖。

谢谢。

issue.title: sessions: two agents told to share one folder under different spellings (a link, a letter's case on Windows) read its sessions twice: Pi and omp, Qoder and Qoder CN

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Found while landing #2932's fix (CodeBuddy Code in WorkBuddy's folder).

#2932's fix keeps each path once in `allFiles` and `callSources` (`distinctPaths`), and reads CodeBuddy Code's folder as WorkBuddy's when `os.SameFile` says the two are one folder. The other pairs of agents that a variable can point at one folder only get the path-text dedup:

- Pi and omp: `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` set to omp's `~/.omp/agent` lists each `sessions/*/*.jsonl` from `piFiles` and `ompFiles`.
- Qoder and Qoder CN: `QODER_CONFIG_DIR` and `QODERCN_CONFIG_DIR` on one folder lists each file from both `ccFiles` calls.

When both spell the folder the same, `distinctPaths` keeps the first listing, so a session is read once (under the first agent's name). When the spellings differ (a symlink or junction, or `C:\Users\x\.qoder` beside `c:\users\x\.qoder` on Windows), the paths differ as text, so each session is listed twice, under both agents, and its calls are counted twice in usage. It no longer crashes: that was the duplicate path in one refresh, fixed in #2932.

Not reproduced with a real install; this is from reading `allFiles`, `piFilesIn`, `ompFilesUnder` and `QoderDir`. A fix would decide the agent for a shared folder as #2932 did for WorkBuddy (`sameFolder` in `internal/sessions/workbuddy.go`), or key the dedup on the file's identity instead of its path text.

issue.title: gateway: 流式下 narration-only 完成被改写为 `finish_reason: "tool_calls"`（mimo 系列必现，导致客户端误判丢工具调用并反复重试）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Bug Description

流式（`stream=true`）转发时，模型纯文字完成（narration-only，无任何工具调用）后，客户端收到的终止帧是
`finish_reason: "tool_calls"`，但整条流中没有任何 `tool_calls` delta。

下游 agent 客户端（如 Hermes Agent）的 dropped-tool-call 恢复逻辑会因此误判"工具调用被丢弃"，同一轮
反复补发提示词要求"把工具调用发出来"，最多重试 3 次才放行——每条纯文字回复多出最多 3 次上游调用
（延迟 + token 成本）。

影响面（同一网关内对照）：

- 必现：`mimo-v2.6-pro` / `mimo-v2.6-flash`（经 OpenAI chat-completions 上游），流式，纯文字完成
- 不受影响：deepseek / glm 系列同网关流式正常；所有模型非流式正常；真实工具调用路径正常
- **不要求请求带 tools**：无 tools 的纯文字流式请求同样复现

## Steps to Reproduce

1. 经 magpie 网关发起流式 chat-completions 请求，model 选 `mimo-v2.6-pro`：

```json
{
  "model": "auto/mimo-v2.6-pro",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "只回复两个字：收到"}],
  "stream": true
}
```

2. 观察 SSE 流终止帧的 `finish_reason`
3. 对照：把 model 换成 deepseek/glm 系列，或同请求设 `"stream": false`，重复 1-2

## Expected Behavior

narration-only 流式完成应返回 `finish_reason: "stop"`（与非流式、与 deepseek/glm 流式行为一致）。

## Actual Behavior

- mimo 系列流式：`finish_reason: "tool_calls"`，且全流 `tool_calls` delta 数量为 0
- deepseek/glm 流式、全部非流式：`finish_reason: "stop"`，符合预期

## 根因线索（直连上游对照）

直连同一上游（OpenAI chat-completions 兼容接口，model=`mimo-v2.6-pro`，`stream=true`）取原始 SSE，
上游末帧 `finish_reason` 是 **`"stop"`，正确**。说明改写发生在 magpie 流式转换层。

两族模型上游末帧 delta 的字段差异是关键线索：

```jsonc
// mimo 末帧 delta —— 显式携带 tool_calls: null 键
{"delta": {"content": null, "role": null, "tool_calls": null, "reasoning_content": null}, "finish_reason": "stop"}

// deepseek 末帧 delta —— 不含 tool_calls 键
{"delta": {"content": "", "reasoning_content": ""}, "finish_reason": "stop"}
```

推测转换层以「delta 是否包含 `tool_calls` 键」判定工具调用活动，`tool_calls: null` 被误判，
进而把终止帧 `finish_reason` 改写为 `tool_calls`。

## 建议修复

判定改为 `delta.tool_calls` **非 null 且数组长度 > 0**；只有整流真实出现过 tool_call delta 时才允许
`finish_reason: "tool_calls"`。建议补回归用例：`stream + tools + narration-only → finish_reason=stop`。

## Environment

- magpie: 0.1.1318（macOS）
- 网关形态：本地 magpie，OpenAI chat-completions 上游（`baseAPI: chat`）
- 受影响模型：mimo-v2.6-pro、mimo-v2.6-flash
- 对照模型：deepseek-v4.1-flash、glm-5.3（正常）

## Additional Context

- 最小复现与三组对照脚本（Python stdlib，可直接跑）可按需提供
- 与 #2471（`finish_reason:"error"` 误判为成功）同属 finish_reason 透传/改写问题域，但触发条件与表现不同

issue.title: rest-cap (and quotaRest) set on a subscription provider is silently ignored: withPicks doesn't carry RestCap/QuotaRest

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

`magpie provider rest-cap <id> 6h` writes `restCap: 360` into `providers.json`, but for subscription (signed-in account) providers the value never reaches the runtime provider — routing keeps using the default cap (10 minutes, 30 when rate limited). Key-based providers work fine.

## Repro

1. On a subscription provider (e.g. `antigravity`, `workbuddy-ai`, `commandcode-plan` — any provider that comes from `Accounts()` rather than a user-typed key):

   ```
   magpie provider rest-cap antigravity 6h
   magpie provider rest-cap antigravity
   # Antigravity · a key or account that keeps failing sits out at most 10 minutes, 30 when rate limited (magpie's own)
   ```

2. `providers.json` does contain `"restCap": 360` on the `antigravity` record, so the write succeeded — but the read-back still shows the default.

3. Same command on a key-based provider (`cloudwise`, `xiaomi`, `opencode-go`) updates and reads back correctly (`sits out at most 6 hours`).

## Root cause

`internal/provider/provider.go` — `allProviders()` builds account-backed providers from `Accounts()` and merges the user's `providers.json` record via `withPicks(a, pk)`. The field list in `withPicks` copies `Models`, `Routing`, `Affinity`, `AccountCaps`, `MaxConcurrency`, `MaxRPM`, … but **not `RestCap`** (and `QuotaRest` is missing too). So for any provider whose provider object is an account clone, the user's rest cap (and quota rest) is dropped and the gateway's `RestCapOr(longestRateRest)` falls back to the default.

Suggested fix: add `a.RestCap, a.QuotaRest = pk.RestCap, pk.QuotaRest` to `withPicks` (they are safe, per-provider knobs like the rest of the copied set).

## Impact

The per-provider rest cap is one of the main levers against fallback chains re-probing a repeatedly failing member every request (TTFT cost). On subscription providers — often the primary member of a routing group — the knob silently does nothing, so repeated 429/unknown failures only back off to 10/30 minutes.

Verified on magpie 0.1.1278 (macOS arm64).

issue.title: 404 for an unknown "auto/…" model reports a synthesized id ("group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash") instead of the id the client sent

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### What happens

An unknown model id that starts with `auto/` makes the gateway report a **synthesized internal id** that the client never sent:

```
POST /v1/chat/completions   {"model": "auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash", ...}
→ 404  magpie knows no model "group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash"; did you mean
       workbuddy-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash, opencode-zen-free/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free,
       openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free?
```

The client sent `auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash`; the message talks about `group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash` — a different string, with the dots rewritten to dashes and a `group/` prefix. That id exists nowhere: it is not in `GET /v1/models`, not in `magpie groups`, and cannot be searched or copied back.

### Why it is inconsistent

| request `model` | 404 message names |
|---|---|
| `auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash` ← synthesized |
| `auto/nope-model` | `group/auto-nope-model` ← synthesized |
| `nosuchgroup/foo` | `nosuchgroup/foo` ← echoed verbatim |
| `magpie/workbuddy-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `magpie/workbuddy-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash` ← echoed verbatim |

So only the `auto/…` path leaks an internal key; every other unknown id is echoed as sent.

### Environment

- magpie `0.1.1296` (Windows 11, gateway on `127.0.0.1:3425`)
- `magpie groups` on this machine lists exactly one auto group: `auto/step-5-preview` (smart, `workbuddy/step-5-preview · workbuddy-ai/step-5-preview`)

### Repro

```bash
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":8}'
```

### Expected

One of:

- echo the requested id verbatim (`magpie knows no model "auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash"`), same as the `nosuchgroup/foo` path, or
- name the real problem: `"auto" is not a routing group; auto groups are named auto/<model> (e.g. auto/step-5-preview)`, or
- list the members of the auto group it matched instead of global-catalog suggestions.

### Why it matters

A client integration that logs the error string will search for `group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash`, find nothing, and conclude the router is broken rather than the model name is wrong. I lost time on exactly this: the real cause was a model id from a different namespace, but the message pointed at an id that does not exist. Echoing the requested string (or saying which group was matched and what it contains) would have made it a one-line fix.

Minor, unrelated: `{"model":"workbuddy-ai/nope"}` returns `400 WorkBuddy AI: model [nope] service info not found` while other unknown models return 404 — upstream pass-through, mentioning only in case 400 vs 404 matters to clients' retry logic.

issue.title: gateway/antigravity: union type ["string","array"] keeps items but collapses to string — Gemini 400 on tool schema

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

A Codex Desktop conversation routed through magpie to an Antigravity account fails before generation when an MCP tool declares a parameter as a JSON Schema type **union** that combines `string` and `array` while also defining `items`.

Observed error:

```text
Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[23].parameters.properties[disease].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[23].parameters.properties[drug].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

HTTP 400, deterministic on every turn that includes the tool. The same tool set works fine through OpenAI-compatible providers on the same gateway.

## Environment

- Client: Codex Desktop, agent `codex@wsl:Ubuntu-22.04`
- Route: Codex → magpie gateway → Antigravity subscription (`gemini-3.8-flash`)
- magpie: `0.1.1306` (Windows)
- Observed: 2026-10-21
- MCP server: `biomcp` 0.9.3 (`biomcp serve`), tool `search`

## Minimal schema shape

The `search` tool declares `disease` and `drug` as:

```json
{
  "disease": {
    "type": ["string", "array"],
    "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 256 },
    "minItems": 1,
    "maxItems": 3,
    "minLength": 1,
    "maxLength": 256,
    "uniqueItems": true
  }
}
```

This is valid JSON Schema: the parameter accepts either a single string or an array of strings.

## Root cause

`plainSchema()` in `internal/gateway/codeassist.go` folds the `type` list like this:

```go
case "type":
    if ts, ok := v.([]any); ok {
        for _, t := range ts {
            if t == "null" {
                out["nullable"] = true
            } else if out["type"] == nil {
                out["type"] = t
            }
        }
    }
```

The first non-`null` member wins, so `["string", "array"]` collapses to `type: "string"`. Meanwhile `case "items"` copies `items` through verbatim. The emitted schema is:

```json
{ "type": "string", "items": { ... }, "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 3, "uniqueItems": true }
```

`uniqueItems` is dropped (outside the subset), but `items`, `minItems`, and `maxItems` all survive on a non-array type — and Antigravity's `Schema.items` predicate requires `$type == Type.ARRAY`, hence the 400.

This is the mirror image of #2784 / #2826 (array schemas missing `items`); here it is `items` surviving on a non-array type.

## Proposed fix

When `type` is a list, pick the member consistent with the schema's sibling keywords rather than blindly taking the first non-null entry. Minimal rule covering this case: if `x["items"] != nil` (or `minItems` / `maxItems` / `uniqueItems` present) and the list contains `"array"`, select `"array"`. Symmetrically, if the chosen type ends up non-array, drop `items`/`minItems`/`maxItems`/`uniqueItems` so the emitted schema stays self-consistent — Gemini validates `items` only against `type`, so either choice unblocks the request.

issue.title: gateway: Qoder's per-model queue 503 rests the whole account, so sibling models are refused without asking upstream

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
# gateway: Qoder's per-model queue 503 rests the whole account, so sibling models are refused without asking upstream

## Summary

A provider that answers a **per-model** rate/queue refusal with a 5xx (Qoder's `503 ... queued the request for <model>`), instead of a 429, is classified as `failOther` and rests the **whole account** (`restKey()`). Sibling models that the same account can still serve are rested with it, and with more than one account the group ends up failover-ing between accounts on the one model that is out, each resting its account.

This is the same shape of problem as #3039 (a relay's model-scoped 429 resting the whole key) and WorkBuddy's "switch to other models" (handled in `restAfterMarked`), but it arrives on a **different branch**: `failOther` rather than `failQuota`/`failRate`.

## The refusal

Qoder answers a congested free model with:

```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable

Qoder: Qoder queued the request for <model> (this plan's queue: p3); try again in 30s
```

The body names exactly one model, and the queue is that plan's queue for that model. The account's other models are not in it and still answer.

## Where it lands

`internal/gateway/routing.go`, `failure(status, body)`:

- `proxyDown` (L351) — no
- `Verification` on 401/403 (L354) — no
- `restrictedSaid` (L360) — no
- `overflowed` (L362) — no
- `status == 402` (L366, L373) — no
- `status == 429` (L375, L381, L385) — no
- `status >= 500 && quotaCodes.Match(body)` (L383) — **no**: `quotaCodes` is `limit reached\|\d{10}\b|usage_limit_reached|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`, and the body says "queued the request"

→ falls through to `return failOther` (L388).

`restAfterMarked`, the `default:` branch (L898–944):

```go
counted := c.restKey()
if unserved {                     // only a model the plan does not serve
    counted = c.restID()
}
```

`unserved` requires `modelRefused(status, body) || codeAssistModelMissing(...)`, neither of which matches a queue refusal. So `counted = c.restKey()`: the **account** rests, on the whole-account backoff ladder (`min(fallbackCooldown<<min(n-1,10), RestCap)`, 1 → 2 → 4 … minutes).

## Why the model-scoping that exists does not catch it

`restAfterMarked` already narrows the rest to the model in four cases (L962–989):

| condition | why it does not apply here |
|---|---|
| `why == failRate && isOpenRouterFree() && sharedPool` | not OpenRouter |
| `pooled \|\| unserved \|\| modelBackoff \|\| why == failQuota && resetsWhen && otherModels` | **requires `failQuota`**; this is `failOther` |
| `why == failQuota && clineModelLimited` | requires `failQuota` |
| `(why == failCredit \|\| why == failQuota) && PaidBesideFree` | requires quota/credit |

Every narrowing branch keys on `failQuota`, `failCredit` or `failRate`; none covers `failOther`, and none matches a body that merely names the model being queued.

`rateRest`'s comment (L1025–1033) shows the same gap from the other side: it notes WorkBuddy's free model being refused repeatedly while the account still had credits, and fixes the **length** of the rest (doubling backoff), but not its **scope** — the account still rests whole.

## Effect

- One model out → every model of that account rests until the ladder ends.
- Two accounts, one model out → each rests its account, and the group alternates accounts on a model that is out for both, paying a whole-account rest each time.
- `magpie accounts` / the Providers page report the account as out although its other models answer upstream.

## Suggestion

Narrow the rest to the model when the refusal names it, on whichever branch it arrives:

- in `failure()`, a 5xx (and a 429) whose body names the model being asked — the way `otherModels` / `modelRefused` already key on wording — could be its own reason, or
- in `restAfterMarked`'s `default:` branch, treat a body naming `c.model` (as `Qoder queued the request for <model>` does) as `unserved`-like for the purpose of the rest key, so `counted = c.restID()`.

Either way the account's siblings keep going upstream, and only the model whose queue refused is benched — matching what the existing WorkBuddy / Cline / OpenRouter branches already do.

## Notes

- Same branch (`failOther`) is reached for any vendor that answers a per-model queue/congestion with a 5xx instead of a 429, so the fix is not Qoder-specific.
- Reported from the Windows desktop build, gateway `v0.1.1307`; the code paths above are read at `origin/main` (`7dd965ed`).

timeline.body:

The shared harness now writes its data with fixed-format `printf '%s\n'`, covering logs, control messages, session JSONL and replies. The cache test decodes the logged JSON and checks the actual prompt and cache-control values, instead of expecting shell-dependent escaped bytes. No production behavior changed.

The original test failed on Bash-as-sh. Keeping the new JSON assertion but restoring the old harness also failed under `BASHOPTS=xpg_echo` with an invalid newline in JSON. The fix passed five consecutive runs in each Bash mode; the related cache/resume/lean/room tests passed in both modes too. Tests ran in a temporary HOME with pinned Go caches. Dash was not installed, so I have not claimed a dash runtime test.

Combined validation: these changes are included in [065f0c8f](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/065f0c8ffc9e30225f3d468ef41ec414aab75e02) on `fix/issue-batch-20261023`. At that exact commit, `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m`, native/Linux/Windows vet and native/Linux/Windows builds all passed with Go 1.26.8, a temporary HOME and pinned Go caches (Linux host, umask 027). Cross-platform builds/vet are not Windows runtime tests. These full-suite results apply to the combined commit; the focused results above apply to the individual fix.

issue.title: [Bug] Antigravity 适配层透传 JSON Schema 联合类型 type:["object","array"] + items，Google 严格校验必 400（带最小复现）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 环境
- magpie `0.1.1323`（macOS 27.0，Apple Silicon，桌面 App + gateway :3425）
- 客户端：Codex CLI（经 Magpie gateway，`group/cap-route` → compact 规则改派 `group/fast`，首跳 `antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`）
- Antigravity 账号已登录，普通请求一切正常

## 现象（确定性，非偶发）
Codex 的**远端压缩请求（remote compaction）携带工具 schema** 发到 Magpie，经 Antigravity 适配层翻译后，Google 返回 400，整轮作废：

```
Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[0].parameters.properties[params].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

## 根因
工具的某个参数（本例是 codex_apps 桥接的 MCP 工具，参数名 `params`）用了**合法的 OpenAI/JSON Schema 联合类型**：

```json
{
  "type": ["object", "array"],
  "description": "Tool params as a real JSON object (an array for the handful of array-body tools) ...",
  "items": { "type": "string" },
  "properties": {}
}
```

Magpie 的 Antigravity 适配层（OpenAI→Gemini 翻译）把联合类型**原样透传**了。Google 的 Schema proto 是严格校验：`items` 字段存在时 `type` 必须恰好是 `Type.ARRAY`（单值），联合类型直接判死。

## 最小复现（同通道三发对照，本机实测）

对 `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions` 发 `model: antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`，tools 里放一个 function，其 `parameters.properties.params` 分别用三种 schema：

| 实验 | `params` 的 schema | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| A | `{"type":["object","array"],"items":{"type":"string"},"properties":{}}` | **HTTP 400**，报错与线上失败逐字一致 |
| B | `{"type":"object","properties":{}}` | ✅ HTTP 200 |
| C | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}` | ✅ HTTP 200 |

复现脚本（A 例）：

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions   -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer magpie"   -d '{
    "model": "antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"回复OK"}],
    "max_tokens": 10,
    "tools": [{
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "test_tool",
        "description": "probe",
        "parameters": {"type":"object","properties":{"params":{"type":["object","array"],"description":"Tool params","items":{"type":"string"},"properties":{}}},"required":[]}
      }
    }]
  }'
```

同一通道、同一账号：干净 schema 秒过，联合类型必炸 ⇒ 问题在翻译层，不在 Antigravity 账号或网络。

## 影响
- 触发条件隐蔽：只有当请求**带工具**且某工具参数用了联合类型时才 400。日常小请求不带工具，所以看起来"偶发"。
- 杀伤大：Codex remote compaction 请求天然带全套工具 schema，命中即整轮作废（实测一次白跑 2598 秒）。路由日志一天 274 条 compact 里 124 条带 tools，只要这批工具里有联合类型参数就可能炸。
- 其他 Gemini 系 provider 若走同一翻译层，可能同样受影响。

## 期望修复
翻译为 Gemini Schema 时做一次规范化（normalization），例如：
- 联合类型 `["object","array"]` → 取第一个非 array 类型（`object`），或拆成 `anyOf` 前先剥掉 Google 不认的字段；
- `items` 仅在 `type == "array"`（单值）时保留，否则丢弃；
- 顺带可考虑 `additionalProperties` / `anyOf` 等 Google proto 不支持字段的通用降级。

## 规避（临时）
路由组里把 `antigravity/*` 从会接收带工具请求的组（如 compact 改派目标 `group/fast`）的**首位**挪走，让带工具的请求首跳到能正确翻译的 provider。

issue.title: [Bug] Codex subagent tasks are ignored when sent as agent_message through Magpie 0.1.1333

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### Summary

Codex subagents start successfully and return responses, but do not act on their assigned tasks when using Magpie 0.1.1333 with `deepseek/deepseek-flash`.

The task is present in the Codex subagent's local session log as a Responses input item with `type: "agent_message"`. However, the model responds as though no task was provided.

Direct requests to Magpie reproduce the same behavior without involving Codex: an ordinary user `message` works, while an `agent_message` containing the same task does not. Both requests return HTTP 200.

### Environment

- **Magpie version:** `0.1.1333`
- **Codex CLI/core version:** `0.163.0-alpha.10.2`
- **Client:** Codex Desktop on Windows
- **Requested subagent model:** `deepseek/deepseek-flash`
- **Model reported in direct API responses:** `deepseek-flash`
- **Subagent reasoning effort recorded by Codex:** `high`
- **Configured Codex base URL:** `http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex`
- **Endpoint used for reproduction:** `POST /backend-api/codex/responses`

Project names in the examples below have been anonymized as `example-project`.

### Expected Behavior

A task carried in a Codex `agent_message` input item should reach the downstream model, allowing the subagent to execute the task.

If this input type is unsupported, an explicit error would be preferable to returning HTTP 200 while the model appears not to receive the task.

### Actual Behavior

The subagent starts and replies, but asks for a task instead of executing the task already provided.

Examples of actual replies, translated from Chinese and anonymized:

> Please tell me what task you want to complete in example-project.

> I am ready to begin working in the current workspace. Please provide the specific requirements.

The subagent makes **zero tool calls**.

This occurred with:
- A minimal read-only command execution task.
- A follow-up task sent to the same subagent.
- A newly created subagent receiving another minimal task.
- A larger, detailed, read-only repository analysis task.

Increasing task size or sending a follow-up did not resolve the issue.

### Steps to Reproduce in Codex

1. Run Codex Desktop through Magpie 0.1.1333.
2. Configure or explicitly select `deepseek/deepseek-flash` as the subagent model.
3. Create a subagent with a concrete task, such as:
   - Execute a read-only PowerShell command.
   - Calculate `19 * 29`.
   - Return `MINIMAL_RETEST_OK|551`.
4. Observe that the subagent asks for a task rather than executing it.
5. Inspect the subagent session log:
   - `turn_context.model` is `deepseek/deepseek-flash`.
   - The assigned task is present as a `response_item` with `type: "agent_message"`.
   - No tool calls occur.

### Minimal API Reproduction — No Codex Required

The following two requests use the same model, the same initial user message, and the same task text. The task item's message type and associated envelope fields are the only intentional differences.

#### A. Ordinary user message — succeeds

```json
{
  "model": "deepseek/deepseek-flash",
  "stream": false,
  "max_output_tokens": 256,
  "input": [
    {
      "type": "message",
      "role": "user",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "input_text",
          "text": "You are ready to receive a task."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "message",
      "role": "user",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "input_text",
          "text": "Message Type: NEW_TASK\nTask name: /root/format_probe\nSender: /root\nPayload:\nReply with exactly FORMAT_PROBE_OK_842. Do not ask for a task."
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Send to:

```text
POST http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex/responses
Content-Type: application/json
```

Observed result:

```text
HTTP 200
Response model: deepseek-flash
Assistant output: FORMAT_PROBE_OK_842
```

#### B. Codex-style agent_message — fails to follow the task

```json
{
  "model": "deepseek/deepseek-flash",
  "stream": false,
  "max_output_tokens": 256,
  "input": [
    {
      "type": "message",
      "role": "user",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "input_text",
          "text": "You are ready to receive a task."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "agent_message",
      "id": "amsg_format_probe_842",
      "author": "/root",
      "recipient": "/root/format_probe",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "input_text",
          "text": "Message Type: NEW_TASK\nTask name: /root/format_probe\nSender: /root\nPayload:\nReply with exactly FORMAT_PROBE_OK_842. Do not ask for a task."
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Send to the same endpoint.

Observed result:

```text
HTTP 200
Response model: deepseek-flash
Assistant output: Ready. Please provide the task.
```

### Reproduction Results

Two pairs of direct API requests were tested, with consistent results:

| Test | Task input type | HTTP status | Result |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Pair 1, control | `message` / `user` | 200 | Returned the requested marker |
| Pair 1, agent task | `agent_message` | 200 | Asked for a task |
| Pair 2, matched control | `message` / `user` | 200 | Returned `FORMAT_PROBE_OK_842` |
| Pair 2, agent task | `agent_message` | 200 | Replied: `Ready. Please provide the task.` |

Pair 2 used the matched payloads shown above.

### Relevant Codex Log Evidence

The actual repository-analysis task was recorded in the subagent session log in this structure. Identifiers and content below are shortened or anonymized:

```json
{
  "type": "response_item",
  "payload": {
    "type": "agent_message",
    "id": "amsg_...",
    "author": "/root",
    "recipient": "/root/project_analysis_test",
    "content": [
      {
        "type": "input_text",
        "text": "Message Type: NEW_TASK\nTask name: /root/project_analysis_test\nSender: /root\nPayload:\n[Complete repository analysis instructions for example-project]\nPROJECT_ANALYSIS_TEST_DONE"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Checks confirmed that:
- The full task text was present.
- The completion marker was present.
- The Chinese task text was intact, with no Unicode replacement characters.
- The actual subagent model matched the requested model.
- Magpie recorded HTTP 200 for the corresponding request.

**Important diagnostic detail:** filtering Codex logs only for `payload.type == "message"` misses these task items. They are stored as `payload.type == "agent_message"`.

### Suspected Cause / Investigation Pointers

This appears to be a compatibility issue in the handling or downstream conversion of Codex `agent_message` input items.

Please check whether:
1. The Responses input parser recognizes `agent_message`.
2. Its `content` is retained during request normalization.
3. The downstream provider adapter converts it into a message format supported by the target model.
4. Unrecognized input item types are silently skipped.

This is a hypothesis, not a confirmed internal root cause. I have not captured the raw request body sent from Magpie to DeepSeek, so I cannot yet determine whether the content is dropped inside Magpie or passed onward in a format the downstream API does not handle.

However, reproducing the issue through direct HTTP requests removes Codex task creation and scheduling from the minimal reproduction.

### Impact

Codex subagent delegation is effectively unusable in this tested configuration: subagents launch successfully but do not act on their assigned task instructions.

Because the requests return HTTP 200 and the subagents produce plausible readiness replies, the failure can be mistaken for a model instruction-following issue rather than a message-format compatibility problem.

### Scope and Workaround

- Confirmed with `deepseek/deepseek-flash` through Magpie 0.1.1333.
- Other downstream models/providers have not been tested in this investigation.
- Ordinary user messages work in direct API tests.
- The available Codex subagent tools do not expose an option to change the underlying task item from `agent_message` to an ordinary user `message`, so the direct API workaround does not fix normal subagent delegation.

issue.title: [Bug] Chat-to-Responses can silently complete Codex turns with no output or stop reason (v0.1.1327)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Problem

On Magpie **v0.1.1327**, Codex can stop mid-task without a final answer when a routing group selects a Chat Completions provider and Magpie translates its response to Responses.

I correlated five real incidents across two local Codex session histories with Magpie's `usage.jsonl` and daily routing traces by `response_id` and `route_id`. All five were logged as HTTP 200, with **no recorded upstream stop reason, no first-token timing, and no error**. Codex then recorded `task_complete` with `last_agent_message: null`, so it did not retry the empty result.

This includes a case where Codex correctly retried an OpenAI/Codex subscription EOF, but the retry selected a Chat provider and ended silently instead.

## Environment

- Windows 11 x64, prebuilt Magpie **v0.1.1327**.
- Binary build revision: `398803e3f575dcafc20573f674a98d71105c9694` (`vcs.modified=false`).
- Codex CLI / VS Code session histories; original session metadata versions 0.163.0 and 0.162.1.
- Model: `gpt-6.1-sol`, reasoning effort `xhigh`.
- Routing group: `auto/gpt-6.1-sol`, containing a Codex subscription and several API providers.
- AIGO and Krill were configured with `baseAPI: "chat"` and a Chat base URL only.
- Route recorded for each silent completion: `/v1/responses -> /v1/chat/completions`.

## Correlated incidents

All timestamps are **UTC+08:00**. The start and duration refer to the final Magpie request, not the entire user turn. Session A/B are anonymized local labels.

| Session | Request start | Final provider | Request duration | Cached input tokens | Output tokens | Codex turn ended |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| A | 2026-10-22 17:06:46.547 | AIGO | 41,327 ms | 50,457 | 1 | 17:07:27.929 |
| A | 2026-10-22 18:24:49.783 | AIGO | 5,759 ms | 50,477 | 1 | 18:24:55.575 |
| B | 2026-10-23 14:15:38.912 | Krill, after a Codex subscription attempt | 206,157 ms total | 0 | 0 | 14:19:05.114 |
| B | 2026-10-23 14:49:59.718 | Krill | 54,525 ms | 0 | 0 | 14:50:54.281 |
| B | 2026-10-23 14:51:25.681 | Krill | 75,085 ms | 0 | 0 | 14:52:40.805 |

For the 206,157 ms request, the routing trace shows two tries: Codex subscription failed with EOF after 156,163 ms, then Krill returned HTTP 200 after 49,748 ms with no recorded usage/output.

A representative usage entry, with identifying fields omitted:

```json
{
  "t": "2026-10-23T14:51:25.6806916+08:00",
  "agent": "codex",
  "provider": "krill",
  "model": "gpt-6.1-sol",
  "status": 200,
  "in": 0,
  "out": 0,
  "cache_read": 0,
  "ms": 75085,
  "response_id": "resp_18e116052510e23c00000579",
  "ep": "/v1/responses -> /v1/chat/completions"
}
```

`stop`, `err`, `ttft_ms`, `first_text_ms`, and `first_reasoning_ms` are **absent**, not literal null values in this entry.

The matching Codex `token_usage_record` has that same `response_id`, all usage counters zero, and is followed by:

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-10-23T06:52:40.805Z",
  "type": "event_msg",
  "payload": {
    "type": "task_complete",
    "last_agent_message": null
  }
}
```

The two AIGO incidents counted cached prompt tokens and one output token, so a check limited to completely uncounted replies would not cover them.

## Example recovery chain

For the 14:50 incident on October 23:

1. At 14:48:01 Magpie starts a Codex subscription request.
2. At about 14:49:59 it fails with `Codex: connection lost mid-reply (unexpected EOF)`.
3. Codex's own log explicitly says `stream disconnected - retrying sampling request (1/5 ...)`.
4. That retry selects Krill, configured on Chat Completions.
5. At 14:50:54 it finishes with zero output and no recorded stop/error; Codex records `task_complete` with no final message.
6. The user sends "continue" at 14:51:25. Affinity keeps Krill, and the next turn ends empty again at 14:52:40.

## Suspected gateway gap

The deployed version's code appears consistent with the false-success behavior:

- [`emptyFails` / `repliesCounted` in gateway.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/398803e3f575dcafc20573f674a98d71105c9694/internal/gateway/gateway.go): the empty-reply checks cover Gemini/Code Assist and uncounted Anthropic/Responses replies, but not ordinary Chat upstreams.
- [`saysItsEnd` / `streamTranslated` in continuation.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/398803e3f575dcafc20573f674a98d71105c9694/internal/gateway/continuation.go): ordinary Chat upstreams, other than Gemini-compatible ones, do not require a terminal marker, and the success path calls `enc.finish()`.
- [`responsesEncoder.finish` in responses.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/398803e3f575dcafc20573f674a98d71105c9694/internal/gateway/responses.go): the default terminal event is `response.completed`.

This is a suspected explanation, not a raw-stream reproduction. I do **not** have the original upstream SSE bytes, so I cannot distinguish an empty upstream response from an event shape the Chat decoder did not recognize. I have not reproduced the incidents on demand or verified a fix.

## Expected behavior

A translated Chat response with no actionable output and no valid terminal reason should not silently end a Codex task as successfully completed. Please surface a recoverable failure or allow the next group member/client retry to answer it. Legitimate empty answers and explicit length/filter endings need to retain their own semantics.

## Workaround verified separately

The same Krill provider/key/model accepts its native `/codex/v1/responses` endpoint. Three small direct requests, without any real session history, verified:

1. Streamed text: `response.created`, text deltas, and `response.completed`, returning `OK`.
2. A forced function call: valid `response.function_call_arguments.delta` events and a completed `function_call` item.
3. Returning that function's output in a subsequent stateless request: text `OK` and `response.completed`.

Adding a Responses endpoint to that provider should let Codex use Responses without Chat conversion. These small tests do not establish reliability for a full long-running Codex session, and do not resolve the separate Codex subscription EOF.

Related: #2086 (fixed empty Anthropic/Responses translations), #3327 (Mistral Chat empty completions, with an explicit provider error flag), and #3135 (separate Codex EOF error-mapping concern).

issue.title: [bug] decide= on a plugin provider (commandcode-plan) reports saved but never persists — Command Code Jev unreachable without a custom-provider detour

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Problem

`magpie provider set commandcode-plan decide=…` prints `✓ saved`, but the field is dropped immediately: the provider entry in providers.json has no `decide`, `magpie provider commandcode-plan` doesn't show it, and `POST /v1/systemone` with `commandcode-plan/typesafe/jev` answers:

```
magpie knows no Jev model "commandcode-plan/typesafe/jev"; name the provider before it, like openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.14
```

Meanwhile a group member on the plan provider gets plain chat completions, which Command Code's chat endpoint refuses:

```
Command Code Plan: Model "typesafe/jev" is not supported on this endpoint.
```

So a decision group can never reach Command Code's Jev through the plan provider.

## Command Code does serve Jev (verified against the live API)

- `POST https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1/systemone`, TypeSafe SystemOne body (`state` + `questions` + `model`), key in `Authorization: Bearer` and `x-api-key`.
- The endpoint's own validation names its models — sending `model: "garbage/vendor-xyz"` returns:

```
Model "garbage/vendor-xyz" is not supported on this endpoint. Use one of: typesafe/jev, typesafe/jev-1.14.0.
```

- The provider's `/provider/v1/models` list (92 models) does not include them, so catalog fetches never reveal Jev.
- On a GOAT account the call currently ends `insufficient credits` (Jev draws from credits, not the plan's usage windows), but route and model validation pass — the wiring is the only gap.

## Workaround (works end-to-end on 0.1.1309)

```
magpie provider add cc-jev decide=https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1 key=<commandcode key> models=typesafe/jev
magpie group add Jev id=jev models=cc-jev/typesafe/jev routing=order
# POST /v1/systemone model=group/jev → reaches the endpoint, fails only on the account's credits
```

Note `decide=` must be the base (`…/provider/v1`); magpie appends `/systemone`.

## Expected

Either keep the k=v fields (`decide`, `url`, …) set on plugin-managed providers, or have the commandcode plugin declare its System One endpoint and the plan's Jev model so `commandcode-plan/typesafe/jev` works directly.

## Version

magpie 0.1.1309, macOS arm64

issue.title: [Bug] redact：普通 key/版本号误判为 SECRET，示例密码导致 paperclip 在后续请求持续被替换

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题

开启内置 secrets 脱敏后，普通仓库/条目标识和软件版本号会被识别为 `SECRET`。被识别过的值随后还会通过 `known` 在其他独立请求中继续被替换。

`paperclip` 的情况需要区分两步：公开连接串示例里的密码位置被识别为 `PASSWORD` 符合当前规则；但识别以后，普通句子 `Open the paperclip repository.` 中的项目名也会持续被替换。干净进程中的这句话本来不会触发。

这会使发给模型的非秘密项目上下文和版本信息被占位符代替。下面全部使用合成值或公开示例，不含真实凭据及用户聊天内容。

## 环境与版本边界

- 实测源码：[main 的固定快照 da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/tree/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a)，提交时间 `2026-10-23T07:45:27Z`。它是开始复现时读到的最新 main，不声称发布本 issue 时的 main HEAD 仍是这个 commit。
- macOS / darwin arm64；Go `1.26.9`。
- 直接调用实际 `internal/redact` 包的 `MaskJSON`，生产源码未修改。
- 配置为 `redact.Options{Secrets: true}`，仅额外设置 `Seen` 收集命中来源；未启用 Personal、本地 PII 模型、自定义词、规则或 allowlist。
- 上游测试的 `TestMain` 隔离用户配置；每个 case 单独启动一个 `go test` 进程，避免不同用例共享 known 状态。

**这里复现的是包函数行为，未运行 GUI、HTTP 网关、模型厂商请求或两个真实客户端会话的端到端链路。**

## 最小复现与实际结果

输入均作为 `messages[0].content` 交给 `MaskJSON`，不是把内层的 `key` 当成顶层协议字段。以下仅把占位符哈希规范化为 `HASH`，类型和 `rule`/`known` 来源来自真实命中。

### 1. 普通记录和版本号被 rule 识别为 SECRET

每一行从全新的测试进程运行：

| 输入 | 实际输出 |
|---|---|
| `{"key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}` | `{"key":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `{"key":"example1234/demo-repository"}` | `{"key":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `{"versionToken":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}` | `{"versionToken":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `tokenspeed-triton: 3.9.10.post20261008` | `tokenspeed-triton: {{SECRET_HASH}}` |
| `tokenspeed-runner: cu130-torch-2.14.0-flashinfer-0.6.18` | `tokenspeed-runner: {{SECRET_HASH}}` |

以上每项都是 1 次 `rule / SECRET` 命中。

### 2. 公开示例密码使普通项目名在后续请求中命中 known

同一进程内依次调用三次 `MaskJSON`。每次请求都只包含当前消息，没有携带前一条消息历史；`prompt_cache_key` 使用不同的标记值：

```text
请求 B-before：Open the paperclip repository.
输出：Open the paperclip repository.
命中：0

请求 A-seed：postgres://paperclip:paperclip@localhost:5432/paperclip
输出：postgres://paperclip:{{PASSWORD_HASH}}@localhost:5432/paperclip
命中：1，rule / PASSWORD

请求 B-after：Open the paperclip repository.
输出：Open the {{PASSWORD_HASH}} repository.
命中：1，known / PASSWORD
```

仓库标识和版本号也有相同传播：

- `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}` 在干净进程中保持原样；先运行上表的 `key` 输入后，再请求同一段 `source_pr_key` 内容，就会命中 `known / SECRET`。
- `{"buildVersion":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}` 在干净进程中保持原样；先运行 `versionToken` 输入后，再请求同一段 `buildVersion` 内容，就会命中 `known / SECRET`。
- `issue_key` 的干净进程对照也不触发。不能把 `source_pr_key`、`issue_key`、`buildVersion` 全部归为直接规则误报。

## 可直接运行的复现测试

在上述固定 commit 的源码树中，将下面完整文件保存为 `internal/redact/discord_repro_test.go`。函数名沿用已实跑的复现文件。

```sh
# 添加复现文件前，原包基线已执行并通过：
go test -count=1 ./internal/redact

# 添加文件后，每项单独启动一个进程。以下三个代表用例应真实 FAIL：
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=repo-key go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=version-token go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=paperclip-propagation go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact

# 正常凭据保护对照应 PASS：
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=api-key-control go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
```

<details>
<summary>完整复现文件：15 个 case，按 MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE 独立运行</summary>

```go
package redact_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"testing"

	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/redact"
)

// Run each case in a fresh go test process so known values cannot leak between cases.
func TestDiscordRedactionRepro(t *testing.T) {
	name := os.Getenv("MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE")
	if name == "" {
		t.Fatal("set MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE; see the accompanying verification record")
	}
	normalize := regexp.MustCompile(`\{\{([A-Z_]+)_[a-z2-7]{8}\}\}`)
	mask := func(request, input string) (string, int) {
		t.Helper()
		var hits []map[string]string
		o := redact.Options{Secrets: true, Seen: func(h redact.Hit) {
			hits = append(hits, map[string]string{"kind": h.Kind, "by": h.By})
		}}
		body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"model": "synthetic", "prompt_cache_key": request,
			"messages": []map[string]string{{"role": "user", "content": input}},
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out, n := redact.MaskJSON(body, o)
		var decoded struct {
			Messages []struct{ Content string }
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &decoded); err != nil || len(decoded.Messages) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("invalid output: %s (%v)", out, err)
		}
		content := decoded.Messages[0].Content
		row, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"case": name, "request": request, "input": input, "masked": n,
			"output": normalize.ReplaceAllString(content, "{{${1}_HASH}}"), "hits": hits,
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Logf("REPRO %s", row)
		if restored := redact.Restore(string(out), false); restored != string(body) {
			t.Fatalf("round trip changed request: %s", restored)
		}
		return content, n
	}
	unchanged := func(request, input string) {
		t.Helper()
		out, n := mask(request, input)
		if out != input || n != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("non-secret text should remain unchanged; masked=%d", n)
		}
	}
	masked := func(request, input string) {
		t.Helper()
		if _, n := mask(request, input); n == 0 {
			t.Fatal("synthetic credential should be masked")
		}
	}

	cases := map[string]string{
		"repo-key":            `{"key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"repo-name":           `{"key":"example1234/demo-repository"}`,
		"version-token":       `{"versionToken":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}`,
		"tokenspeed-triton":   `tokenspeed-triton: 3.9.10.post20261008`,
		"tokenspeed-runner":   `tokenspeed-runner: cu130-torch-2.14.0-flashinfer-0.6.18`,
		"fresh-source-pr-key": `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"fresh-issue-key":     `{"issue_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"fresh-build-version": `{"buildVersion":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}`,
	}
	if input, ok := cases[name]; ok {
		unchanged("fresh", input)
		return
	}
	switch name {
	case "repo-propagation":
		input := `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		mask("conversation-a-seed", cases["repo-key"])
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "version-propagation":
		input := cases["fresh-build-version"]
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		mask("conversation-a-seed", cases["version-token"])
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "paperclip-propagation":
		const input = "Open the paperclip repository."
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		masked("conversation-a-seed", "postgres://paperclip:paperclip@localhost:5432/paperclip")
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "api-key-control":
		masked("control", `{"api_key":"sk-proj-SYNTHETICONLY0123456789abcdef"}`)
	case "generic-key-control":
		masked("control", `{"key":"NotARealCredential1234567890abcdef"}`)
	case "db-password-control":
		masked("control", "postgres://demo:SyntheticOnlyPass123@127.0.0.1/demo")
	case "short-password-control":
		masked("seed", "postgres://demo:pass@127.0.0.1/demo")
		unchanged("after", "The tests pass.")
	default:
		t.Fatal("unknown case: " + name)
	}
}
```

</details>

## 预期行为与已完成验证

希望非秘密的项目标识、版本号和普通项目名保留原文，同时继续保护真实凭据；尤其希望避免一次误识别使后续无关请求持续受影响。不是建议关闭整个 known 机制，也不是建议把 `paperclip` 在所有上下文中一概放行。

已实际执行：

- 加入复现文件前，原有 `internal/redact` 包退出码为 0，记录了 58 个测试 PASS 事件，无 FAIL/SKIP。
- 15 个 case 分别在独立进程中执行：5 项直接规则误报和 3 项 known 传播序列的“非秘密文本应保持不变”断言失败；其余 7 项对照通过。这些 FAIL 是问题复现，不是编译失败。
- 7 项对照为：干净进程的 `source_pr_key`、`issue_key`、`buildVersion`；合成 API key、普通 key 字段中的合成凭据、合成 URL 密码；短示例密码 `pass` 不会扩散到普通句子 `The tests pass.`。
- 每一步都验证了 `Restore` 能还原原始 JSON；这里未观察到 JSON 还原失败。

## 源码线索与相关反馈

固定版本的 [redact.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a/internal/redact/redact.go) 中，裸 `key` 的宽泛值规则及字段名中的 `token` 子串匹配能够触发上述样本；[known.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a/internal/redact/known.go) 会在进程内记住长度至少 8 的值，并在后续请求中按同值及边界匹配。尚未实现修复，希望协助确认规则及 known 的置信度/上下文边界。

相关但不同的反馈：[文件名被识别为 EMAIL](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3029)、[PII 模型误判协议字段为 PERSON](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3144)。本报告不依赖本地 PII 模型，只启用内置 secrets 检测，并在消息正文里复现。

AI 辅助披露：Codex 协助调查、编写复现及整理本报告。上述命令已实际执行；没有生产修复，也没有把未运行的 GUI/网关端到端验证写成已通过。

issue.title: [Bug] Command Code built-in: stealth/reflection models 400 on replayed turns — reasoning_content is not replayed via the API-key host

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
**What happens**

With the built-in `commandcode` provider (API key; host `api.commandcode.ai`), the stealth/reflection models fail on every turn that replays an assistant message through the Responses→Chat relay:

- `commandcode/stealth/cat-jam:free` — first turn 200; every later turn 400.
- `commandcode/reflection/beam:free` — same.
- `commandcode/stealth/glyph-cluster:free` — unaffected.

Seen through a client (Codex via `/v1/responses`, magpie 0.1.1276):

```
[System Error] {"error":{"code":null,"message":"Command Code: {\"error\":{\"message\":\"The stealth model could not complete the request.\",\"type\":\"provider_error\"}}","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

It is a fast deterministic 400 (~230 ms). Replaying the relay's Chat request shape directly against beam surfaces the real validation error:

```
Missing required parameter: 'messages[1].reasoning_content'. This model needs the reasoning of every earlier assistant message
```

**Minimal repro (single factor)**

Same chat body, only the assistant message differs:

- `[user, user]` → 200
- `[user, assistant]` → 400
- `[user, assistant + reasoning_content]` → 200 (both cat-jam and beam)

Other free models through the same relay replay assistant tool turns fine (`openrouter/free`, `opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free`, `opencode-zen/glm-5.3-flash-free`), so the gap is specific to these Command Code models.

**Source reading**

`chatReplaysReasoning` in `internal/gateway/chat.go` (v0.1.1276):

```go
func chatReplaysReasoning(host, model string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(host, "deepseek") || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(model), "deepseek") || host == provider.CommandCodePlanID
}
```

`buildHost` returns the plugin id only for plugin providers; the built-in provider returns `api.commandcode.ai`, so `replay` is false and `buildChat` never adds `reasoning_content` to the replayed assistant tool turns. The comment on `chatReplaysReasoning` says "Command Code's plugin, which replays it for a Go key as the built-in did to /alpha/generate" — it looks like the built-in's replay was scoped to the old `/alpha/generate` path, but the current built-in stealth/reflection models (served through `/provider/v1`) want it back too.

**Suggested direction**

Also replay for the Command Code built-in host (e.g. match `api.commandcode.ai`, or the `stealth/` / `reflection/` model prefixes), the way #1462 handled DeepSeek's variants.

**Workaround**

`magpie model disable commandcode/stealth/cat-jam:free commandcode/reflection/beam:free` removes them from the catalog and every group immediately (direct calls then 403). An exposure-level unpick (`magpie provider models commandcode -stealth/cat-jam:free ...`) is not enough: named group members are not filtered by the served list — `membersIn` only honors the disabled-models list. Note too that the 400 does not trigger group failover, so a group whose first member is cat-jam dies on its second turn.

Related: #1462 (DeepSeek rejects replayed tool turns without reasoning), #1765 (repeated 400s with no failover).

issue.title: gateway: SophNet's model-scoped 429 ("Model tpm limit exceeded") rests the whole key, greying out every model on it

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

When a SophNet model answers a **model-scoped** 429, magpie rests the **whole API key**, so every sibling model on that key is greyed out on the Routing page (`rate limited · back in 59 s`) and gets a local 429 without the request ever reaching upstream.

This is the same shape as #3039 (a relay's `for model <X>` 429) and #3213 (Qoder's per-model 503), but it arrives with **different wording** that none of the existing matchers catch:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests

{"error":{"message":"SophNet: Model tpm limit exceeded. Please try again later."}}
```

## Evidence from the gateway trace

A group `group/deepseek-v4-flash` with three members on one SophNet key. The first member gets the 429 above, and `/api/gateway/trace` records the rest against the **key**:

```json
{
  "id": "sophnet",
  "model": "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017",
  "status": 429,
  "fail": "rate",
  "error": "SophNet: Model tpm limit exceeded. Please try again later.",
  "rest": {
    "why": "rate",
    "status": 429,
    "until": "2026-10-25T22:54:24Z",
    "by": "cooldown",
    "failures": 1,
    "key": "sophnet@api key …pncw"      // ← whole key, not restID()
  }
}
```

The next two members were tried within ~1s and each got its own 429, after which all three rows showed `rate limited · back in 59 s`. The same happens for every other model on that key.

## Expected

Recognise `Model <name> limit exceeded` (and similar "the limit is for this model" phrasing) as a **model-scoped** refusal and call `c.restID()` instead of `c.restKey()`, like `otherModels` does for `switch to other models` in #3039.

The distinction matters here: SophNet's console exposes per-model TPM/RPM (e.g. 600k TPM, 120 RPM per model), so a `Model tpm limit exceeded` does not necessarily mean the key's whole quota is gone. If the sibling models are in fact on a shared pool, letting the request go upstream and answer its own 429 is still more truthful than pre-emptively refusing it locally with another model's error text.

## Trade-off worth considering

I understand the conservative choice (don't hammer a key that just 429'd). A middle ground could be: rest the model immediately, but for siblings only apply a short "probe" cooldown (or none), and rest the whole key only if a second distinct model on the same key also 429s.

## Environment

- magpie 0.1.1543, Linux (workstation), custom SophNet plugin provider (`@ai-sdk/openai` / `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`, per-model `limit.context` / `limit.output`)
- Three channels under one SophNet API key: `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, `-global`, `DeepSeek-Flash-1017`, routed `order`/`auto`
- Reproduced by sending concurrent requests through the group until SophNet answers `Model tpm limit exceeded`

## Workaround

Routing page → `Try now` on the key lifts the rest immediately (as #3039 notes); restarting magpie also clears it.

issue.title: [Bug] Claude Desktop 网关模式开了 Enable tool search 后，Copilot 拒绝 tool-search-tool-2025-10-19（400 unsupported beta header），每个会话第一个请求失败，工具搜索实际没生效

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
**English summary:** With Claude Desktop's gateway mode pointed at magpie and its *Enable tool search* setting on (`toolSearchEnabled`), Claude Code asks tool search by Bedrock's and Vertex's beta name, `tool-search-tool-2025-10-19`, because Desktop runs it with experimental betas off. Copilot's Messages API refuses that name: `400 unsupported beta header(s): tool-search-tool-2025-10-19` on the first request of every Desktop session (and on its `count_tokens` calls). Claude Code then turns tool search off for the session and resends with every tool schema inline, so the setting never takes effect through magpie + Copilot. Copilot serves the same request shape (deferred tools, `tool_reference` results) under Anthropic's own name, `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20`, which is what Claude Code sends from a terminal. magpie already renames this beta the other way for Bedrock (`bedrockBetas`). A reference fix renames it for Copilot accounts, with a test and real runs against a Copilot Business account: mdwsk88/magpie, branch [`copilot-tool-search-beta`](https://github.com/mdwsk88/magpie/tree/copilot-tool-search-beta), commit [eed4be36f](https://github.com/mdwsk88/magpie/commit/eed4be36f6c789cddce51eb77c1f9d3ccf08cc64).

## 现象

- 环境：magpie v0.1.1346（macOS app），Claude Desktop 第三方网关模式（自带 Claude Code 2.1.308），模型走 Copilot Business 的 claude-opus-5.5 和 claude-sonnet-5.5。
- 2026-10-24 12:16，在 Desktop 的 Developer › Configure Third-Party Inference 里打开 Enable tool search（magpie 写的那份配置里多了 `toolSearchEnabled: true`）。
- 从那以后，每个新开或恢复的会话，第一个请求都失败。routing 日志记的是 `Copilot: unsupported beta header(s): tool-search-tool-2025-10-19`（err_type `invalid_request_body`），当天出现 3 次（12:16、13:15、13:26）。
- Claude Code 收到 400 后不报错，而是关掉这个会话的工具搜索，把所有工具定义内联后重发。以 13:26 那个会话为例：第一个请求 37,411 tokens（其中工具 17,119），重发后 100,290 tokens（工具 71,336），之后每个请求都带着约 10 万 tokens 的工具定义。会话里会出现 "ToolSearch is no longer available" 的提示。
- 所以这个开关经 magpie + Copilot 从来没真正生效过，每个会话还白白多一次失败的请求。

## 原因

- **Claude Code 怎么选 beta 名：** 2.1.308 按实验 beta 是否打开来定。打开时用 Anthropic 自己的名字 `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20`，关闭时用 Bedrock/Vertex 的名字 `tool-search-tool-2025-10-19`。
- **Desktop 网关模式发的是哪个：** Desktop 用 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1` 关掉实验 beta。Enable tool search 则通过它传给 CLI 的托管设置 `--managed-settings {"env":{"ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH":"force"}}` 强制打开（CLI 只在 `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST=1` 时读这份设置）。所以 Desktop 发的是 `tool-search-tool-2025-10-19`。Desktop 自带的配置说明也写明：网关 provider 只会加这个 beta 值，再加上延迟加载和 `tool_reference`。
- **Copilot 不认这个名字，认另一个：** Copilot 的 `/v1/messages` 和 `count_tokens` 都拒绝 `tool-search-tool-2025-10-19`，接受 `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20`。终端里的 Claude Code（自定义 base URL，实验 beta 开着）发的正是这个名字，延迟加载和 `tool_reference` 经 magpie + Copilot 都正常（10-24 实测 13 个请求全部 200）。
- **magpie 只改了一个方向：** `internal/gateway/betas.go` 的 `betas()` 只给 Bedrock 改名（`bedrockBetas`：advanced → tool-search），没有反方向。
- **magpie 也学不会这个拒绝：** `refuseBetas` 只认 Bedrock 的 "Unexpected value(s) … for the `anthropic-beta` header"，认不出 Copilot 的 "unsupported beta header(s): …"，所以每个会话都会再撞一次。就算认出来，去掉这个 beta 后延迟加载也用不了，所以该改名，不该丢掉。

## 修复（参考实现）

mdwsk88/magpie 分支 [`copilot-tool-search-beta`](https://github.com/mdwsk88/magpie/tree/copilot-tool-search-beta)，commit [eed4be36f](https://github.com/mdwsk88/magpie/commit/eed4be36f6c789cddce51eb77c1f9d3ccf08cc64)，基于 upstream 7edf5b0：

- `internal/gateway/betas.go` 新增 `copilotBetas`（`tool-search-tool-2025-10-19` → `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20`）。`betas()` 对 Copilot 账号（`p.Account.Agent == "copilot"`）按它改名，改名放在去重之前，所以两个名字一起给时只发一次。`/v1/messages` 和 `count_tokens` 都走 `forward` → `betas()`，两条都覆盖。只改 Copilot；其他 provider 照 Claude Code 给的名字发，Bedrock 的逻辑不变。
- `docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md`：在讲延迟加载工具的几条后面加了一条说明。
- 新测试 `TestCopilotToolSearchBeta`：
  - 假的 Copilot Messages API 拒绝 `tool-search-tool-2025-10-19`（错误文本和类型取自 magpie 用量日志里记下的真实拒绝），接受 `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20`。请求的 beta 列表和形状（`DeferredToolPlaceholder`、延迟的 MCP 工具、`tool_reference`）取自一次真实的 Desktop 网关模式运行。
  - 检查六件事：Copilot 收到改名后的列表，顺序不变，只请求一次；延迟工具和 `tool_reference` 原样到达；终端那个名字原样发出；两个名字无论哪个在前都只发一次；`count_tokens` 也改名，且答案来自 Copilot 而不是 magpie 的估算；不是 Copilot 的 provider 收到原名。

## 验证

在 upstream 7edf5b0 上加这次改动（go1.26.9，macOS，临时 HOME，Go 缓存固定在原位置）：

- **新测试通过。** 故意改坏三种方式，每种都会失败：
  - 去掉改名（即旧代码）：`Desktop's tool search on Copilot: status 400: {"error":{"message":"Copilot: unsupported beta header(s): tool-search-tool-2025-10-19",...}}`。单独测 `count_tokens` 也是同样的 400。
  - 改名对所有 provider 生效：`relay was asked [...advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20...], want ...tool-search-tool-2025-10-19...`。
  - 改名放到去重之后：`Copilot was asked "advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20,advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20"`。
- **构建和全量测试：** 改动的文件 `gofmt -l` 无输出；`go vet ./...` 在 darwin、linux（`-tags nogui`）、windows 上都通过；三个平台的 `go build` 都通过。`go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...`：70 个包里 69 个通过（internal/gateway 451 秒）。唯一失败的是 internal/update 的 `TestRelaunchOpenTriedAgain`（`TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat …/003: directory not empty`），和这次改动无关：它在 upstream 7edf5b0 和这个分支上单独各跑 20 次都通过，internal/update 整包在这个分支上 `-count=3` 也通过。从代码看，测试一看到假 `open` 写了 "opened" 就返回，而分离出去的 relaunch shell 还会往那个 TempDir 里的日志追加一条 "open try" 记录（`relaunchScript` 的 `note`），全量测试负载高时会和清理撞上。这个还没单独报。
- **真实验证：** macOS，Copilot Business。临时 HOME 里只放一份 Copilot 登录的副本，`security` 命令换成永远返回"找不到"的替身，所以没有读写真钥匙串，也没有碰正在运行的 magpie 和它的配置。请求方是 Desktop 自带的 Claude Code 2.1.308，带一个 stdio MCP 测试工具，要求模型调用它。

  | magpie | 请求形态 | 结果 |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | upstream 7edf5b0 | Desktop 网关模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1`、`CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST=1`、`--managed-settings {"env":{"ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH":"force"}}`），Sonnet 5.5 | 第一个请求 400 `Copilot: unsupported beta header(s): tool-search-tool-2025-10-19`；Claude Code 关掉工具搜索，32 个工具内联重发，请求从 90 KB 变成 149 KB |
  | 修复后 | 同上，Sonnet 5.5；另跑一次 Opus 5.5 [1m] | 全部 200：ToolSearch `select:mcp__probe__echo_probe` → 下一个请求带着 `tool_reference` → 调用延迟加载的 MCP 工具，结果正确；请求一直在约 90 KB |
  | 修复后 | 终端形态（`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=true`，发 `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20` 和其他实验 beta） | 全部 200，同样走通 ToolSearch → `tool_reference` → 调用 |
  | upstream 7edf5b0 / 修复后 | 直接请求 `count_tokens`：Desktop 的 beta 列表加一个延迟工具 | 修复前 400（同一句报错）；修复后 200，`{"input_tokens":77}`，是 Copilot 自己算的数 |

- **没试：** GHE（`*.ghe.com`）上的 Copilot 账号（同一个 `Agent == "copilot"` 分支，没有真账号可试）；修复后的版本接真实 Desktop app（实测用的是同一个 CLI 二进制，参数和环境变量与 Desktop 启动时一致）。

## 用户侧的临时办法

在修复发布前，Enable tool search 配 Copilot 不会生效，每个会话还多一次失败的请求，可以先关掉（同一个菜单，重启 Desktop 后生效）。关掉后上下文用量和现在一样，因为现在本来就在退回全量工具。

## 相关

- #2971 说的是终端里的 Claude Code 对非官方 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 默认关闭工具搜索，开关是 `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH`；这里是 Desktop 网关模式，开关是 Desktop 的 `toolSearchEnabled`，问题出在 beta 的名字上。
- 没改：`refuseBetas` 认不出 Copilot 的拒绝措辞（`unsupported beta header(s): x`），所以 Copilot 拒绝的其他 beta 也不会被记住和去掉，每次都会失败。这次的 beta 不能靠去掉解决，所以没放进这个修复；需要的话可以另开一个。

issue.title: [Bug] 走 Messages API 的 Claude 回复，用量里的推理 token 恒为 0（aUsage 不读 output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
**English summary:** magpie's usage records how much of a reply was reasoning for Chat (`completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`), Responses and Gemini (`thoughtsTokenCount`) replies, and for the Claude subscription path (`cliUsage.gateway()` reads `output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens`). The Anthropic Messages path doesn't: `aUsage` in `internal/gateway/anthropic.go` has no `output_tokens_details`, so every Claude reply over the Messages API (Anthropic, Copilot, Bedrock, relays) is recorded with reasoning 0, whether it is relayed (`usageSniffer`) or translated (the Anthropic decoder). As a result `reasoning_tokens` is 0 in `magpie usage --csv` for all of that traffic, `DecodeOf` times such a reply as if it had no reasoning, and a Chat/Responses upstream's reasoning count is dropped when its reply is translated for an Anthropic client such as Claude Code (the Chat and Responses encoders do carry it). A reference fix with tests is on mdwsk88/magpie, branch `gateway-anthropic-thinking-tokens` (commit [9feac29c6](https://github.com/mdwsk88/magpie/commit/9feac29c6c5f1bd7e0601dc9c77be0bbfb0f4395)).

## 现象

Claude Code（Claude Desktop 的第三方模式）经 magpie 用 Copilot 的 claude-opus-5.5。Copilot 每个回复的 `message_delta` 都带思考 token 数，例如 2026-10-24 的一次（effort high）：

```
"usage":{"cache_creation_input_tokens":3858,"cache_read_input_tokens":12030,"input_tokens":2,...,"output_tokens":1277,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":710}}
```

magpie 记下的这一行：output 1277，reasoning 0。2026-10-23 我们做 A/B 测试时，magpie 记下的 277 个经 Copilot 的 claude-desktop 请求，`magpie usage --csv` 的 `reasoning_tokens` 每一行都是 0；同一批运行里，Claude Code 自己的 result 用量都带思考 token 数。

## 原因

- `internal/gateway/anthropic.go` 的 `aUsage` 只读 input、output、cache 几个字段，没有 `output_tokens_details`，`aUsage.usage()` 也就不会填 `Usage.Reasoning`。
- 透传的回复（`sniff.go` 的 Anthropic 分支）和转译的回复（Anthropic 解码器处理 `message_delta`）都经过它，所以两条路都丢。
- 同一个仓库里，`claude_subscription.go` 的 `cliUsage.gateway()` 读了 `output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens`；Chat、Responses、Gemini 的用量也都填了 `Reasoning`。只有 Messages API 这一处漏了。
- 和 #1578 不是同一个原因：那里是请求被路由到 Chat Completions 才丢了思考统计，这里是 Messages API 本身的用量没读这个字段。
- 反方向同理：`Usage.anthropic()` 不写思考 token，Chat 或 Responses 上游的推理数转给 Claude Code 时被丢掉；`Usage.chat()` 和 Responses 的编码都带着。

## 影响

- 用量页和 CSV 里，所有走 Messages API 的 Claude 请求推理数都是 0（Anthropic 官方 API、Copilot、Bedrock、各种中转）。
- 输出速度：`DecodeOf` 对有推理数的回复，只按回答部分、从第一个文字算起；Claude 回复的推理数是 0，就按整段输出（含思考）、从第一个内容算起，和其他协议的口径不一致。
- Claude Code 接 Chat 或 Responses 上游时，拿不到思考 token 数。

## 修复（参考实现）

mdwsk88/magpie 分支 `gateway-anthropic-thinking-tokens`，commit [9feac29c6](https://github.com/mdwsk88/magpie/commit/9feac29c6c5f1bd7e0601dc9c77be0bbfb0f4395)：

- `aUsage` 加 `OutputTokensDetails{ThinkingTokens}`，`usage()` 把它填进 `Usage.Reasoning`；
- `Usage.anthropic()` 在 `Reasoning > 0` 时写回 `output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens`（为 0 时输出不变）。

新测试：

- `TestAnthropicThinkingTokensCounted`：用上面那次 Copilot 回复的原始字节（签名截短），分别经 `/v1/messages`、`/v1/chat/completions`、`/v1/responses`，检查用量行的 reasoning 是 710，以及客户端拿到的 usage 里有这个数。
- `TestTranslatedReasoningToldAsThinkingTokens`：Chat 上游报 `reasoning_tokens: 100`，Claude Code 客户端的 `message_delta` 里应有 `"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":100}`。

## 验证

在 upstream b437e4a 上加这次改动（go1.26.9，macOS，临时 HOME，Go 缓存固定在原位置）：

- 两个新测试通过。把 `anthropic.go` 换回原样后两个都失败：三条路径都报 `thinking tokens not counted: 200 output 1277 reasoning 0`；转译的回复报 `message_delta doesn't tell the thinking tokens`。
- 改动的文件 `gofmt -l` 无输出；`go vet ./...` 在 darwin、linux（`-tags nogui`）、windows 上都通过；三个平台 `go build` 都通过。
- `go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...`：69 个包全部通过（internal/gateway 426 秒）。
- 没试：拿改过的版本接真实上游。测试用的是 Copilot 真实回复的字节；Anthropic 官方 API 也返回同一个字段。

## 相关观察（不在这次修复里）

- Copilot 的 `message_delta` 还带 `copilot_usage`：按类型列出 token 数和单价，以及 `total_nano_aiu`（上面那次是 4724400000）。magpie 的 credits 字段现在只给 WorkBuddy 的 `usage.credit` 用；如果想显示 Copilot 的 AI 用量，可以从这里取。
- 顺带确认过、不需要改 magpie 的两件事：
  - Copilot 单次回复超过约 630 秒会被对端断开（`CANCEL; received from peer`），magpie 已经按协议补发 `event: error`（`streamFailure`）。
  - Copilot 不发思考进度（`thinking_delta` 里没有 `estimated_tokens`）。magpie 转发了 `thinking-token-count-2026-05-13` beta，是 Copilot 那边没给。

issue.title: [Bug] gateway/Kimi: typed $ref target containing an untyped object oneOf still causes schema rejection

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题

Magpie 的 Kimi Code 路线能处理 `$ref` 直接指向无类型 `oneOf` 的简单情况，但下面这种**已声明类型的引用目标内部再包含无类型 oneOf**仍返回：

```text
400 Kimi Code (China): tools.function.parameters is not a valid moonshot flavored json schema,
details: <At path 'properties.x': detected infinite recursion without termination condition>
```

最小复现没有引用循环。只给内部 union 补 `type: object`，相同路线返回 200 / OK。

关联：[WorkBuddy 插件 #378 的三路实测补充](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/issues/378#issuecomment-6394043743)。本 issue 聚焦 Magpie 自身的 `kimi-code-cn` 网关路径；WorkBuddy/Qoder 插件的整理逻辑由插件仓库处理。

## 最小请求

发送到已配置 Kimi Code 的 Magpie 网关 `POST /v1/chat/completions`：

```json
{
  "model": "kimi-code-cn/k3.1-pro",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Do not call tools. Reply exactly OK."}],
  "tools": [{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
      "name": "probe",
      "description": "Diagnostic placeholder.",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {"x": {"$ref": "#/$defs/X"}},
        "$defs": {
          "X": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "y": {
                "oneOf": [
                  {"type": "object", "properties": {"mode": {"type": "string", "const": "a"}}},
                  {"type": "object", "properties": {"mode": {"type": "string", "const": "b"}}}
                ]
              }
            },
            "required": ["y"]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }],
  "max_tokens": 32000,
  "reasoning_effort": "high",
  "stream": false
}
```

唯一改动：给 `tools[0].function.parameters.$defs.X.properties.y` 加 `"type": "object"`。原始请求 400，修改后 200 / OK；将 `X` 内联、移除这次引用，也能成功。

## 实际 dsh 验证

2026-10-25，以 `dsh headless 0.2.1-rc.2` 运行完整 REA 工具集，共 198 个工具，其中 170 个 REA 工具：

- 原始工具集：Kimi Code 返回 400，错误位置 `properties.after_scenario`，dsh 退出码 1。
- 在临时诊断请求中给 object-only 的无类型 oneOf 补类型：200，最终回复 `OK`，dsh 退出码 0，持久化 session 为 `completed`。
- 实际路由已由网关记录确认是 `kimi-code-cn`，返回模型为 `k3.1-pro`。
- 最终规则在这份工具集中命中 55 处，涉及 29 个工具；含仅接受直接 object 分支的 54 处版本时，Kimi Code 已成功。第 55 处是本地引用分支，对 WorkBuddy/Qoder 插件路径也必要。

原始工具定位为 `mcp__rea__compare_web_captures`。`after_scenario` 的引用目标自身已有 object 类型，但其后代 `steps → items → artifacts` 中有未声明类型的 object union。对完整 compare 工具补齐 12 个同类节点后，单工具请求也成功。

## 当前源码线索

检查时 main 为 `1b039a3c7247d0221fb0b8ed8ef89a35ffd8e9d6`：

- [`collectRefTargets`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/1b039a3c7247d0221fb0b8ed8ef89a35ffd8e9d6/internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go#L289) 按 `$ref` 查找直接目标。
- 直接目标已有 type 时，`untypedForKimi` 将其排除；目标内部未被另一个 `$ref` 单独引用的无类型 union，未由这个动作补类型。

本次测试时 Magpie 安装文件为 0.1.1485，未重启网关，运行中进程的精确版号未单独确认。上述 main 源码是独立只读检查，未把它当成运行中进程的源码证明。实网失败/成功对照发生在同一运行环境。

## 与 #3205 的区别

[#3205](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3205) 处理 `{format, description, $ref}` 引用链中间节点被错误添加 type 的问题。本复现的 `X` 已明确为 object，没有引用链中间节点，也不需要在 `$ref` 旁增加 type；缺失的是内部 `y.oneOf` 的 type。因此应单独跟踪，但两个修复需要互相保护。

## 建议验收

1. 覆盖“直接引用无类型 union”和“typed 引用目标内部的无类型 union”。
2. 仅在各分支均明确为 object 时补 object 类型；本地引用需检查缺失和循环，不向引用链中间节点插类型。
3. 保留 anyOf、混合类型 union、examples/default 和非 Kimi 路线的既有语义。
4. 最小复现及真实 REA schema 均做回归；正式版本再跑完整 dsh 会话。

测试只修改工作目录内的诊断请求，没有更改现有配置或插件。现有 34 个配置、插件及程序文件校验和保持一致。本次验证工具声明和文本回合，没有实际执行 REA 工具或验证多轮调用。

issue.title: [Bug] Routing: live request's Context window card says "the model's window isn't known" while the model's window is known

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## What happens

On the Routing page (`?view=routing`), the **Context window** card of an in-flight request shows:

```
CONTEXT USED
107K tokens
THE MODEL'S WINDOW ISN'T KNOWN
```

even though the same model's window is known everywhere else — the provider panel on the right of the same page shows `1M`, and `magpie model context sophnet/glm-5.3-flashx` prints `1M`.

This happens for every model and every routing group, as long as the request is still running (the card carries the green **Live** badge). Once the request finishes, the card shows the window correctly.

## Root cause (from the gateway's own data)

`GET /api/gateway/trace` returns `routes[]` where the in-flight entries have no `prompt.window`, while finished entries do:

```
in-flight (done=false):
  group/sonnet-5-5        prompt.window=null  prompt.tokens=410997
  group/deepseek-v4-flash prompt.window=null  prompt.tokens=110233

finished (done=true):
  prompt.window=1000000  prompt.tokens=98913
  prompt.window=1000000  prompt.tokens=99238
```

`context.js` then renders the fallback text:

```js
const window = p.window || 0;
...
} else sub.textContent = t("the model's window isn't known");
```

So the window is only filled in when the trace row is finalized; the live row never carries it, even though the model (or every member of the group) already has a known `limit.context` in the catalog.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Configure a routing group, e.g. `group/deepseek-v4-flash` (three SophNet channels).
2. Send a request through the gateway from any agent (Claude Code is the easiest).
3. Open `?view=routing` while the request is running.
