issue.title: Chat passthrough for a "deepseek"-named upstream: injected `reasoning_content` collides with the client's echoed `reasoning` — 400 "duplicate field \`reasoning\`

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## TL;DR / 中文摘要

本地部署的 DeepSeek 引擎（serde 反序列化）把 `reasoning_content` 视为 `reasoning` 的同一字段（别名）。客户端（pi、dsh）会把它自己流式收到的思考以 `reasoning` 字段回传到历史消息里。而 magpie 对 host/model 含 "deepseek" 的 Chat 上游，在工具调用轮给这些消息**追加** `reasoning_content`（`withReasoningOnToolTurns`），却不删除原有的 `reasoning`。两条消息字段同现，服务端反序列化直接报：

```
400 {"code":"json_parse_error","message":"deepseek: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: messages[6]: duplicate field `reasoning` at line 1 column 70565","param":null,"type":"invalid_request_error"}
```

结果：**只要走 magpie 且模型发起工具调用，紧随其后的每一条请求必 400**；不经 magpie 直连则一切正常。

## Environment

- magpie 0.1.1307 (installed, Windows 11 x64); verified against source commit `b855cfee`
- Clients: `pi` (OpenAI Chat) and `dsh`; both process-local
- Upstream: **self-hosted local DeepSeek engine** ("DeepSeek-Flash", OpenAI Chat-compatible, host redacted; both `/v1/chat/completions`; endpoint types incl. openai/anthropic/responses)

## What happens

For a request relayed as Chat to an upstream whose host or model contains `deepseek` (`chatReplaysReasoning`), magpie adds `reasoning_content` to every assistant tool-call turn — and to the reply turns after tool results — via `withReasoningOnToolTurns` (`internal/gateway/chattidy.go`, called from the `provider.Chat` branch in `internal/gateway/gateway.go`).

The engine this client talks to **streams assistant thinking in `reasoning`** (not `reasoning_content`). The client therefore echoes earlier tool-call turns' thinking in `reasoning`. After magpie's injection those messages carry **both** fields, and the engine's serde rejects a message with both keys mapped to the same struct field:

```text
duplicate field `reasoning` at line 1 column …
```

Every request of such a turn fails, so the whole tool call loop breaks. Direct (no magpie) sends only one field and works.

## Behavior verified directly against the engine (bypassing magpie)

Same conversation, assistant turn with `tool_calls` + tool result, only the assistant fields differed:

| assistant message fields | result |
| --- | --- |
| `"reasoning": "…"` only | **200** |
| `"reasoning_content": "…"` only | **200** |
| both | **400** `duplicate field \`reasoning\`` (exact error above) |

## magpie-side evidence

While routing `pi` and `dsh` through magpie, magpie's own usage ledger shows the identical shape every time on this provider:

- `pi`: 200 (`stop: "tool_calls"`) → next request **400** (user-visible: `messages[9]`)
- `dsh`: 200 (`stop: "tool_calls"`) → next request **400**, retry **400** (user-visible: `messages[6]`)

All other turns (no tool call, `stop: "stop"`) succeed — they don't match `withReasoningOnToolTurns`' injection condition, so no field collision.

## Why I think it's on the magpie side

The replay rule exists because official API assumes a **DeepSeek-style upstream that wants `reasoning_content` back on tool turns**. This engine is a DeepSeek-model Chat API too, but it *names* the field `reasoning` (that's what it streams) and tolerates reading the thinking from either name alone — just not both at once. The injection therefore assumes the more common client shape (thinking absent, or echoed as `reasoning_content`) and leaves any client-echoed `reasoning` in place.

## Suggested fix (draft)

In `withReasoningOnToolTurns` (`internal/gateway/chattidy.go`), after taking the thinking text, **remove the fields it was taken from** before writing `reasoning_content`, so the thinking is carried exactly once:

```go
think := reasoningText(m)
if think == "" {
    think = noReasoning
}
// the thinking rode in `reasoning`/`reasoning_details`: they go, or an
// upstream that reads both into one field (`reasoning`, with
// `reasoning_content` an alias) takes the message apart instead
// ("duplicate field `reasoning`")
for _, f := range messageReasoning[1:] {
    delete(m, f)
}
m["reasoning_content"], _ = marshalPlain(think)
```

(And in the early-return branch where the message already has a non-empty `reasoning_content`, drop leftover `reasoning`/`reasoning_details` the same way, returning `true` when it changed.)

Note this is lossless for official-style upstreams: the thinking still reaches the model — just under the name they actually read — and a client that echoed thinking in `reasoning` stops producing a two-key message. Possibly the same collision exists on the Kimi path (`reasoningDetailsAsContent` keeps `reasoning` while adding `reasoning_content`); not checked.

## Related observation

A `codex` run routed to the same engine through `/v1/responses` also failed with 400s around the same time (a different shape — `input[…]-level errors, not this exact text). Didn't repro it; mentioning in case it's the same vector from the Responses side (`withReasoningText`).

## Workarounds tried

- No config switch found for the replay/injection (checked settings + providers).
- Renaming the model inside magpie (to a name without `deepseek`) risks breaking upstream model resolution; no alias mapping exists in `providers.json`.
- Removing the client's echoed `reasoning` client-side isn't configurable either (pi/dsh echo the field the engine itself streams).

So for now, bypassing magpie for this provider is the practical workaround.

issue.title: TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback is red on Go 1.27: its probe reuses a kept-alive connection after the WSL listener closes

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
`TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback` (`internal/gateway/wsl_test.go`) fails 3 of 3 on main c158b0439 with go1.27.2 darwin/arm64, and passes 3 of 3 there with go1.26.8 (go.mod's, CI's). I couldn't find it filed. #3547 and #3549 are the other Go 1.27 reds from the same run.

```
--- FAIL: TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback (10.03s)
    wsl_test.go:165: WSL network gone: http://[::1]:58208/ answers = true
```

Run, in a sandbox HOME at c158b0439 with nothing else changed:

```sh
GOTOOLCHAIN=local   go test -tags nogui -count=3 -run '^TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback$' ./internal/gateway/   # go1.27.2: FAIL
GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 go test -tags nogui -count=3 -run '^TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback$' ./internal/gateway/   # ok
```

**Likely cause, checked once:** `answers()` makes a new `http.Client` with no Transport, so every probe goes through `http.DefaultTransport` and its pool of kept-alive connections. After "WSL network up", the pool holds a connection to `[::1]:port`. Closing the WSL listener doesn't close connections it has already accepted, so the "WSL network gone" probe is answered over that connection, and on Go 1.27 it holds for the whole 10s wait. With only the probe changed to `&http.Client{Timeout: time.Second, Transport: &http.Transport{DisableKeepAlives: true}}`, the test passes 3 of 3 on go1.27.2. Not checked: what changed between 1.26 and 1.27 to make the old connection last the wait.

The call is magpie's: keep fastjson's (json/v2-aligned) raw behavior and pin
the divergence in the test per Go version, or escape with 1.27 when not
escaping HTML to keep the equivalence.

issue.title: [Feature Request] Export gateway token names via OTLP / 在 OTLP 上报中包含网关 token 名称

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 中文

### 需求与使用场景

希望在 OpenTelemetry / OTLP 上报中包含请求使用的**网关 token 名称**，即用户为网关密钥设置的名称，而不是 token 的值。

当多个用户、客户端或服务通过不同的网关 token 共用一个 Magpie 实例时，希望直接在 Langfuse 或其他 OTel 收集器中按名称筛选请求、排查失败，并统计 token 用量和延迟。仅有 agent、provider、model 或 route ID，无法直接完成这种归属分析。

### 当前行为

在检查的基线 `c9d253e4a` 上：

- 用量记录和路由记录已保存 `CallerKeyName`，但 OTLP 属性白名单不导出它。
- 网关 observer 的请求父记录及各次尝试记录没有携带该名称。
- `routeID` 可以关联本地路由记录，但收集器无法仅凭该 ID 得知名称。导出时反查也依赖路由记录是否仍在内存或已完成异步落盘。

### 期望行为

建议新增字符串属性 `magpie.gateway_key.name`：

1. 在网关请求父 span、各次路由尝试的子 span（包括失败、重试和 fallback）、独立用量记录导出的 span 中包含名称。
2. 开启 metrics 时，在请求时长和输入/输出 token 直方图中增加同一维度。
3. 使用请求认证时确定的名称；没有名称时省略属性，不影响无网关 token 的请求和本地会话追踪。
4. 只导出名称，不导出网关 token 的秘密值或 ID，也不扩大供应商账号/密钥信息的导出范围。
5. 更新 OTLP 文档和隐私说明，明确名称会发送到用户配置的收集器。

名称不是唯一 ID；不同 token 使用相同名称时，按此维度统计会归入同一组。

### 已有实现与验证

已在 fork 提供参考实现，尚未合入上游：

- Commit: [`9d82162aaea4ddc132a48de899aba736ef2f3ff2`](https://github.com/reyoung/magpie/commit/9d82162aaea4ddc132a48de899aba736ef2f3ff2)
- Branch: [`reyoung/magpie:feat/otel-gateway-key-name`](https://github.com/reyoung/magpie/tree/feat/otel-gateway-key-name)

实现从认证上下文捕获名称，沿 observer 的记录传递给 exporter，避免在异步导出阶段反查路由历史。

OTel 相关测试、针对性 race 检查、Linux（nogui）/Windows vet 和构建已通过；去掉名称传递或属性导出后，回归测试会失败。`go test -tags nogui ./... -timeout 45m` 完整运行后唯一失败项是已有的 shell 兼容性问题 #3280（`TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged`）。未连接真实 Langfuse 验证，也未进行 Windows 运行时测试；不声明全量测试通过。

## English

### Request and use case

Please include the **gateway token's user-assigned name** in OpenTelemetry / OTLP exports, rather than the token's secret value.

When several users, clients or services share a Magpie instance through different gateway tokens, this would let us filter requests, investigate failures, and group token usage and latency by name directly in Langfuse or another OTel collector. Agent, provider, model and route ID alone do not provide this attribution.

### Current behavior

At the inspected baseline, `c9d253e4a`:

- Usage and routing records already store `CallerKeyName`, but the OTLP attribute allowlist omits it.
- The gateway observer's root and per-attempt records do not carry the name.
- A `routeID` can correlate local routing records, but does not tell the collector the name. Looking it up during export also depends on whether the route is still in memory or has finished being written asynchronously.

### Expected behavior

Add a string attribute such as `magpie.gateway_key.name`:

1. Include it on gateway root spans, routing-attempt child spans—including failures, retries and fallbacks—and standalone ledger spans.
2. When metrics are enabled, include it as a dimension on operation-duration and input/output token histograms.
3. Use the name captured from the authenticated request. Omit the attribute when the name is empty; preserve unkeyed requests and local conversation tracing.
4. Export only the name, never the gateway token's secret or ID, without expanding exports of provider account/key information.
5. Update the OTLP reference and privacy disclosures to state that names are sent to the user's configured collector.

Names are not unique identifiers: tokens sharing a name would be grouped together under this dimension.

### Reference implementation and validation

A reference implementation is available in the fork and has not been merged upstream:

- Commit: [`9d82162aaea4ddc132a48de899aba736ef2f3ff2`](https://github.com/reyoung/magpie/commit/9d82162aaea4ddc132a48de899aba736ef2f3ff2)
- Branch: [`reyoung/magpie:feat/otel-gateway-key-name`](https://github.com/reyoung/magpie/tree/feat/otel-gateway-key-name)

It captures the name from the authenticated caller and carries it through observer records to the exporter, avoiding route-history lookups during asynchronous export.

The OTel tests, targeted race checks, Linux (nogui)/Windows vet and builds passed. Removing name propagation or attribute export makes the regression tests fail. The completed `go test -tags nogui ./... -timeout 45m` run had one failing test: the existing shell-portability issue #3280 (`TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged`). A real Langfuse collector and Windows runtime behavior have not been tested; this is not a claim of a green full suite.

issue.title: routing: a Remote magpie's gateway keys are weighed by the limit that magpie holds them to

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## What

Under **Least used first**, **Smart** or **By pace**, a magpie that uses several Remote magpies (or several gateway keys of one) ordered those keys only by the tokens it had sent each lately. It never read the limit each key is held to on the other magpie. That limit was already read for the Usage page (the key card from yetone/magpie#1547, `GET /v1/magpie/limit`), but routing didn't use it. So a key nearly spent there by that magpie's other users still went first, and rested only once it was refused.

Now a Remote magpie key reads its own windows the way a sub2api key does:

- `readsKeyWindows` is true for a Remote magpie key. `keyWindows` reads it through `remoteKeyWindows`, from the same `/v1/magpie/limit` answer the key's card uses, in one shared cache (`readRemoteKey`). An answer that was asked earlier is never kept over a later one. Each key is still asked with itself only.
- When a card is read on the Usage page, routing gets the result at once (`noteRemoteKeyAllowance`).
- A key held to **no limit** gives routing no window (`routedKeyWindows`), so it is weighed like any key that reports nothing, and its card still says "no limit". Under Least used it goes after a key that has a known share with room left. That is the existing rule from yetone/magpie#4535, unchanged.
- A limit that covers only some models is not a window, the same as on the card. A refusal for one of those models rests only that model, as before.
- Keys are read again within the minute, even when no window was found: the remote answers from its own count and asks no vendor.
- Only the remote's own answer sets a Remote magpie key's windows. A balance or plan card read on this magpie, such as a balance the user typed for the provider, leaves them alone.
- `withKeyReadings` skips Remote magpie keys, so their limits never turn into this magpie's own cards for a third magpie.

Docs: `docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md`, in the routing table and the Remote magpie APIs section.

## Run

Rebased onto yetone/magpie main `60f0433d1` (204 commits, no conflicts; none of them touch the three provider files). At the pushed head `1cd5f2f76` (same tree as `c30b8b375`, where the suite ran; only the commit message differs):

- `go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...` in a sandbox HOME: **92 packages ok**. `internal/gateway` is red in `TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged` only. That is yetone/magpie#3280 (red wherever `/bin/sh` is bash, as it is on this machine). Run alone at `60f0433d1` without this change, it fails the same way.
- `go test -tags nogui -race -count=3 -run TestRemoteMagpieKeysWeighedByTheirLimits ./internal/gateway`: ok
- `go test -run 'RemoteMagpie|RemoteKey|KeyLimit|KeyAllowance|KeysWeighed|KeyWindow|KeyOutOfItsWindow|KeyBack' ./internal/gateway ./internal/provider`: ok
- `gofmt -l`: clean. `GOOS=linux go vet -tags nogui ./...` and `GOOS=windows go vet ./...`: ok. `GOOS=linux go build -tags nogui ./...` and `GOOS=windows go build ./...`: ok

**Broken by hand:** with the three provider files put back to c9d253e4a and the new test kept, `TestRemoteMagpieKeysWeighedByTheirLimits` fails with `office#6691's limit never read`.

**Not tried:**
- Two real magpies on two computers. The test runs two in-process gateways.
- A magpie added by hand as an OpenAI-compatible provider. It is not `IsRemoteMagpie`, so this change doesn't cover it.

**Side effect to know about:** when a remote key goes from full to not full, a rest on one of that remote's models for running out of quota can lift a little early. The cost is one extra request to that model.

issue.title: routing: weigh a Remote magpie's gateway keys by the limit left on that magpie / 路由按远端 magpie 上网关 key 的剩余限额排序

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
**English** · [中文](#中文)

## What

When a magpie uses one or more **Remote magpie** providers (or several gateway keys of one), routing should weigh each gateway key by the limit the other magpie holds it to: how much of that limit is left and when it resets.

Today, under **Least used first**, **Smart** or **By pace**, a Remote magpie key is "not known" to routing. Those keys are ordered only by the tokens *this* magpie sent each one lately (half-life 1h, forgotten on restart). The remote already tells each key its own limit at `GET /v1/magpie/limit` (#1547), and the Usage page shows it on the key's card, but routing never reads it. So:

- a key nearly spent on the remote (by that magpie's other users, or another computer using the same key) still goes first;
- it only stops being used after the remote refuses it with a 429 + `X-Magpie-Limit-Reset`.

## Proposed change (implemented)

Commit **`1cd5f2f764efcf1aa2af92614929903fb62d79de`**, on top of `60f0433d1`: https://github.com/reyoung/magpie/commit/1cd5f2f764efcf1aa2af92614929903fb62d79de (PR in the fork: https://github.com/reyoung/magpie/pull/1)

A Remote magpie key now reads its own windows the way a sub2api key does:

- `readsKeyWindows` is true for a Remote magpie key. `keyWindows` reads it through `remoteKeyWindows`, from the same `/v1/magpie/limit` answer the key's card uses, in one shared cache (`readRemoteKey`; an answer asked earlier is never kept over a later one). Each key is still asked with itself only.
- A card read on the Usage page tells routing at once (`noteRemoteKeyAllowance`).
- A key held to **no limit** gives routing no window (`routedKeyWindows`), so it is weighed like any key that reports nothing (#4535's rule, unchanged); its card still says "no limit".
- A limit that covers only some models is not a window, the same as on the card.
- Keys are read again within the minute even when no window was found (the remote answers from its own count and asks no vendor), not after `keyNoWindowsAge`.
- Only the remote's own answer sets a Remote magpie key's windows: a balance or plan card read here (e.g. a balance the user typed) can't overwrite them.
- `withKeyReadings` skips Remote magpie keys, so their limits never become this magpie's own cards for a third magpie.

Resulting order under Least used: keys with a limit and room (by share used) → keys with no limit (by tokens sent lately) → keys at 90%+ → keys at 98%+ (spent). Resting keys still go last.

## Verified

At `60f0433d1` + this change:

- `go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...` in a sandbox HOME: 92 packages ok. `internal/gateway` is red only in `TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged`, which is #3280 (`/bin/sh` is bash here); it fails the same way at `60f0433d1` without this change.
- New test `TestRemoteMagpieKeysWeighedByTheirLimits`: ok 3/3 under `-race`; with the provider files put back, it fails (`office#…'s limit never read`).
- `gofmt -l` clean; Linux (nogui) and Windows `go vet` / `go build` ok.

Not tried: two real magpies on two computers (the test uses two in-process gateways). A magpie added by hand as an OpenAI-compatible provider (not `IsRemoteMagpie`) is not covered.

Related: #1547, #4535, #3705.

---

## 中文

## 需求

当一个 magpie 使用一个或多个 **Remote magpie** provider（或同一个远端的多个网关 key）时，路由应当按另一台 magpie 给每个网关 key 设的限额来排序：这个限额还剩多少、什么时候重置。

现在选 **最少使用优先**、**Smart** 或 **按节奏** 时，Remote magpie 的 key 对路由来说是「额度未知」，只按*本机*最近经它转发的 token 数排序（半衰期 1 小时，重启清零）。远端其实已经在 `GET /v1/magpie/limit` 告诉每个 key 自己的限额（#1547），用量页的 key 卡片也显示了，但路由从来没读。结果是：

- 一个在远端快被用完的 key（被远端其他用户，或另一台用同一个 key 的电脑用掉）照样排在最前面；
- 只有等远端回了带 `X-Magpie-Limit-Reset` 的 429，它才会休息。

## 实现（已完成）

提交 **`1cd5f2f764efcf1aa2af92614929903fb62d79de`**，基于 `60f0433d1`：https://github.com/reyoung/magpie/commit/1cd5f2f764efcf1aa2af92614929903fb62d79de （fork 内的 PR：https://github.com/reyoung/magpie/pull/1）

Remote magpie 的 key 现在像 sub2api key 一样读取自己的额度窗口：

- 对 Remote magpie key，`readsKeyWindows` 为 true；`keyWindows` 通过 `remoteKeyWindows` 读取，数据和 key 卡片同一份 `/v1/magpie/limit` 回答，共用一个缓存（`readRemoteKey`；较早发出的请求结果不会覆盖较晚的）。每个 key 仍然只用它自己去查询。
- 用量页读到卡片时，立即告知路由（`noteRemoteKeyAllowance`）。
- 远端**没设限额**的 key 不给路由任何窗口（`routedKeyWindows`），按「未知」处理（#4535 的规则，未改）；卡片上仍显示「无限额」。
- 只针对部分模型的限额不算窗口，与卡片一致。
- 即使没读到窗口，也一分钟内重新读（远端只读自己的计数，不问任何厂商），不走 `keyNoWindowsAge`。
- 只有远端自己的回答能设置 Remote magpie key 的窗口：本机读取的余额或套餐卡片（比如用户手填的余额）不会覆盖它。
- `withKeyReadings` 跳过 Remote magpie key，它们的限额不会变成本机的卡片再转给第三台 magpie。

最少使用优先下的顺序：有限额且有余量（按已用比例）→ 没设限额（按最近转发的 token）→ 已用 90% 以上 → 已用 98% 以上（用完）。正在休息的 key 仍排在最后。
